title.zh: 卷九十 列傳第二十八: 趙元 移剌道本名按 高德基 馬諷 完顏兀不喝 劉徽柔 賈少沖子:益 移剌斡里朵 阿勒根彥忠 張九思 高衎 楊邦基 丁暐仁
title.en: Volume 90 Biographies 28: Zhao Yuan, Yiladaobenmingan, Gao Deji, Ma Feng, Wanyanwubuhe, Liu Huirou, Jiashaochong Son: Yi, Yilawoliduo, Aleigenyanzhong, Zhang Jiusi, Gao Kan, Yang Bangji, Ding Weiren
title.raw: 卷九十 列傳第二十八: 趙元 移剌道本名按 高德基 馬諷 完顏兀不喝 劉徽柔 賈少沖子:益 移剌斡里朵 阿勒根彥忠 張九思 高衎 楊邦基 丁暐仁 Volume 90 Biographies 28: Zhao Yuan, Yiladaobenmingan, Gao Deji, Ma Feng, Wanyanwubuhe, Liu Huirou, Jiashaochong Son: Yi, Yilawoliduo, Aleigenyanzhong, Zhang Jiusi, Gao Kan, Yang Bangji, Ding Weiren

sentences.zh: 趙元，字善長，涿州范陽人。

translations.literal: Zhao Yuan, courtesy name Shanchang, was a native of Fanyang in Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yuan, styled Shanchang, came from Fanyang in Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遼天慶八年登進士第，仕至尚書金部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianqing of Liao he passed the jinshi examination and served up to Assistant Secretary in the Bureau of Metals of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his jinshi degree in the eighth year of the Tianqing era under the Liao and rose to become an assistant secretary in the Ministry of Revenue's Bureau of Metals.

sentences.zh: 遼亡，郭藥師為宋守燕，以元掌機宜文字。

translations.literal: When Liao perished, Guo Yaoshi guarded Yan for Song and assigned Yuan to manage confidential documents.
translations.idiomatic: After the Liao fell, Guo Yaoshi held Yan for the Song and put Yuan in charge of confidential correspondence.

sentences.zh: 王師取燕，藥師降，樞密使劉彥宗辟元為本院令史。

translations.literal: When the imperial army took Yan, Yaoshi surrendered; Grand Councilor Liu Yanzong recruited Yuan as clerk of his bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin army seized Yan, Yaoshi defected, and Grand Councilor Liu Yanzong brought Yuan on as a clerk in his bureau.

sentences.zh: 天會間，同知薊州事。

translations.literal: During the Tianhui era he served as deputy commissioner of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianhui reign period he served as deputy prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 有賊殺人橫道，官吏圜視莫知所為，路人耕夫聚觀甚眾。

translations.literal: A bandit killed someone across the road; officials stood in a circle looking on and knew not what to do; passersby and farmers gathered in great numbers to watch.
translations.idiomatic: When a killer struck someone down in the road, the local officials stood about in a daze, unsure what to do, while a large crowd of passersby and farmers gathered to watch.

sentences.zh: 元指田中釋耒而來者曰：「此賊也。」

translations.literal: Yuan pointed to one coming from the field who had set down his plow and said: "This is the murderer."
translations.idiomatic: Yuan pointed at a man walking over from the fields after setting down his plow and said, "That is the killer."

sentences.zh: 叱左右縛之，遂伏。

translations.literal: He ordered those at his side to bind him, and he thereupon confessed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his attendants to seize the man, who promptly confessed.

sentences.zh: 僚吏問其故，元曰：「偶得於眉睫間耳。」

translations.literal: His subordinate officials asked the reason; Yuan said: "I happened to see it in the blink of an eye."
translations.idiomatic: When his colleagues asked how he knew, Yuan replied, "I simply caught it with my own eyes."

sentences.zh: 其後朝廷立磨勘格，凡嘗仕宣和者皆除名籍，元在磨勘中。

translations.literal: Thereafter the court established scrutiny regulations; all who had served during the Xuanhe era were struck from the registers, and Yuan was among those under scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Later the court instituted merit review rules that struck everyone who had served in the Xuanhe era from the registers; Yuan fell under this review.

sentences.zh: 齊國廢，置行台省於汴，選名士十余人備官屬，元在選中，授行兵部郎中。

translations.literal: When Qi was abolished, a Branch Secretariat was established at Bian; more than ten distinguished scholars were selected for staff positions, Yuan among the selection, and he was appointed Branch Bureau Director of War.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qi state was abolished, the court set up a Branch Secretariat at Bianjing and selected more than a dozen eminent scholars for its staff; Yuan was chosen and appointed director in the Branch Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 行台徙大名，再徙祁州，及宗弼再取河南，元皆攝戶部事，賦調兵食取辦。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat moved to Daming, then again to Qizhou; when Zongbi again took Henan, Yuan on each occasion acted as head of the Household Bureau, supplying provisions for taxes, troops, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: As the secretariat moved first to Daming and then to Qizhou, and when Zongbi reconquered the Henan region, Yuan each time oversaw the Household Bureau, procuring tax levies and military provisions as needed.

sentences.zh: 天眷三年，為行台右司員外郎，囚有殺人當死者，行台欲宥之，元不從，反復數四，勢不可奪，乃仰天歎曰：「如殺人者可宥，死者複何辜，何欲徼己福而亂天下法乎？」

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianjuan he was Branch Right Bureau Assistant Director; a prisoner guilty of murder deserving death—the Branch Secretariat wished to pardon him; Yuan would not agree, arguing back and forth four times; the force of argument could not be overcome; he then sighed toward heaven saying: "If murderers may be pardoned, what guilt had the dead? Why seek one's own blessing and throw the laws of the realm into disorder?"
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianjuan (1140) he served as assistant director of the Branch Secretariat's right bureau. When a murderer sentenced to death was to be pardoned by the secretariat, Yuan refused to agree. After arguing back and forth several times without budging, he looked up to heaven and sighed: "If killers may be pardoned, what wrong did the dead commit? Why seek personal merit by overturning the laws of the land?"

sentences.zh: 行台竟不能奪。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat in the end could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat could not overrule him in the end.

sentences.zh: 改左司員外郎，攝吏部事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Bureau Assistant Director and acted as head of the Personnel Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as assistant director of the left bureau and oversaw the Personnel Bureau.

sentences.zh: 在行台凡十年，吏事明敏，宗弼深知之，行台或有事上相府，宗弼必問「曾經趙元未也？」

translations.literal: At the Branch Secretariat for ten years in all, his official business was clear and keen; Zongbi knew him thoroughly; when the Branch Secretariat had business to report to the Grand Council, Zongbi would always ask "Has this passed through Zhao Yuan?"
translations.idiomatic: During ten years at the secretariat his administrative work was sharp and capable; Zongbi came to know him well. Whenever the secretariat sent business up to the grand council, Zongbi would ask, "Has this gone through Zhao Yuan?"

sentences.zh: 其見重如此。

translations.literal: Such was the regard in which he was held.
translations.idiomatic: This was how highly he was valued.

sentences.zh: 為同簽汴京留守事，改同知大名尹，用廉遷河北西路轉運使，曆彰德、武勝等軍節度使，以老致仕，卒於家。

translations.literal: He served as co-signatory of the Bianjing garrison affairs, was changed to deputy prefect of Daming, was promoted through integrity to transport commissioner of Hebei West Circuit, successively held military commissioners of Zhangde, Wusheng and other armies, retired on account of age, and died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He served as co-signatory for the Bianjing garrison, then as deputy prefect of Daming. Promoted on merit to transport commissioner for the Hebei West Circuit, he later held successive military governorships at Zhangde, Wusheng, and elsewhere. He retired in old age and died at home.

sentences.zh: 移剌道

translations.literal: Yiladao
translations.idiomatic: Yiladao

sentences.zh: 移剌道，本名按。

translations.literal: Yiladao, original name An.
translations.idiomatic: Yiladao, whose original name was An.

sentences.zh: 宗室移剌古為山東東路兵馬都總管，辟掌軍府簿書，往來元帥府計議邊事，右副元帥宗弼愛其才，召為元帥府令史。

translations.literal: The imperial clansman Yilagu served as overall commander of military forces of Shandong East Circuit; he recruited him to manage the military headquarters records; he went back and forth to the Marshal's Headquarters to discuss border affairs; Right Deputy Marshal Zongbi admired his talent and summoned him as clerk of the Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansman Yilagu was overall commander of military forces in Shandong East Circuit and recruited him to manage headquarters records, sending him back and forth to the marshal's headquarters to discuss border affairs. Right Deputy Marshal Zongbi admired his ability and summoned him as a clerk at the marshal's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 補尚書省令史，特除監察御史，再遷大理丞，兼工部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed clerk of the Ministry of Revenue, specially promoted to Investigating Censor, then again transferred to Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and concurrently Assistant Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, then specially promoted to investigating censor, later transferred to assistant director in the Court of Judicial Review while also serving as assistant director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 海陵南伐，使督運芻糧，所在盜起，道路梗澀，間關僅至淮南。

translations.literal: When Hailing campaigned south, he was sent to supervise transport of fodder and grain; bandits rose everywhere; roads were blocked and difficult; he barely reached Huainan after many hardships.
translations.idiomatic: During Hailing's southern campaign he was ordered to supervise the transport of fodder and grain. Banditry broke out everywhere and the roads became impassable; he barely reached Huainan after a perilous journey.

sentences.zh: 上謁，承問，具言四方盜賊狀，海陵惡聞其言，杖之七十，使督戰艦渡江，會海陵死，軍還。

translations.literal: He had an audience and, responding to questions, fully reported the condition of bandits in all directions; Hailing hated to hear his words and had him beaten seventy strokes, then sent him to supervise warships crossing the river; when Hailing died, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: At an audience he answered the emperor's questions by reporting in detail on banditry throughout the realm. Hailing hated to hear it and had him beaten seventy strokes, then ordered him to supervise warships crossing the Yangzi. When Hailing died, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，除工部郎中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he was appointed Bureau Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162) he was appointed director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 奉詔招撫諸奚。

translations.literal: He received an edict to pacify and win over the various Xi tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He received orders to pacify and win over the various Xi tribes.

sentences.zh: 是時，抹白猛安下謀克徐列等皆欲降，制于猛安合住，不敢即降。

translations.literal: At this time, under the Mobai regiment commander, the company commanders Xulie and others all wished to surrender, but were restrained by regiment commander Hezhu and dared not surrender at once.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the company commanders Xulie and others under the Mobai regiment commander all wished to surrender, but were held back by regiment commander Hezhu and dared not do so immediately.

sentences.zh: 道發兵掩襲合住子婦孫男女甥，及謀克留住，及蒲輦白撒妻孥。

translations.literal: Dao sent troops in a surprise attack to seize Hezhu's daughters-in-law, grandsons, granddaughters, and nephews, and company commander Liuzhu, and the wife and children of Pulian Baisa.
translations.idiomatic: Dao sent troops in a surprise raid to seize the wives, children, and other kin of Hezhu, company commander Liuzhu, and Pulian Baisa.

sentences.zh: 是日，適窩斡遣白撒發抹白猛安軍，白撒聞其家人被獲，遂來降。

translations.literal: That day it happened that Wohe sent Baisa to mobilize the Mobai regiment army; Baisa heard his family had been captured and thereupon came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Wohe had sent Baisa to mobilize the Mobai regiment army; when Baisa learned his family had been seized, he surrendered at once.

sentences.zh: 改禮部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Bureau Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 從討窩斡，佩金牌，與應奉翰林文字訛里也招降叛奚。

translations.literal: He followed in the campaign against Wohe, wore the golden tablet, and with Hanlin Academy Attendant Euliji won over the rebellious Xi to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against Wohe, wore the golden tablet of authority, and together with Hanlin attendant Euliji induced rebellious Xi to surrender.

sentences.zh: 奉使河南，勸課農桑，密訪吏治得失。

translations.literal: On a mission to Henan he encouraged agriculture and sericulture and secretly inquired into the gains and losses of official administration.
translations.idiomatic: On a mission to Henan he promoted farming and sericulture while quietly investigating the strengths and failings of local governance.

sentences.zh: 累遷御史中丞、同修國史，廉問職官殿最，還奏。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Censor-in-Chief and Associate Compiler of National History; he conducted integrity inquiries into officials' merits and demerits and returned to report.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to censor-in-chief and associate compiler of the national history, conducted integrity reviews ranking officials' performance, and reported back to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「職官貪污罪廢，其餘因循以苟歲月。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Officials guilty of corruption are to be dismissed; the rest drift along merely to get through the months.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Corrupt officials are to be dismissed; the rest merely drift along to get through their terms.

sentences.zh: 今廉能即與升除，無以慰百姓愛留之意，可就遷秩，秩滿升除。」

translations.literal: Now to promote the honest and capable at once cannot satisfy the people's wish to keep them; they may be given immediate rank advancement, and when their term is complete be promoted."
translations.idiomatic: Promoting the honest and capable immediately will not satisfy the people who wish to keep them. Advance their rank for now and promote them fully when their term ends."

sentences.zh: 於是，廉能官景州刺史耶律補進一階，單州刺史石抹靳家奴、泰甯軍節度副使尹升卿、甯陵縣令監邦彥、浚州司候張匡福各進兩階。

translations.literal: Thereupon the honest and capable officials—Jing Prefecture Governor Yelü Bu advanced one rank; Shan Prefecture Governor Shimoji Jianianu, Taining Army Deputy Military Commissioner Yin Shengqing, Ningling County Magistrate Jian Bangyan, and Jun Prefecture Station Officer Zhang Kuangfu each advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly the honest and capable officials were rewarded: Jing Prefecture governor Yelü Bu advanced one rank, while Shan Prefecture governor Shimoji Jianianu, Taining Army deputy commissioner Yin Shengqing, Ningling county magistrate Jian Bangyan, and Jun prefecture station officer Zhang Kuangfu each advanced two ranks.

sentences.zh: 貪污官同知浚州防禦使事蒲速越、真定縣令特謀葛並免死，杖一百五十，除名。

translations.literal: The corrupt officials—Deputy Commissioner of Jun Prefecture Defense Affairs Pusuyue and Zhending County Magistrate Temuge—were both spared death, beaten one hundred fifty strokes, and struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Corrupt officials Deputy Commissioner of Jun Defense Affairs Pusuyue and Zhending county magistrate Temuge were both spared execution, beaten one hundred fifty strokes, and struck from office.

sentences.zh: 同知睢州事烏古孫阿里補杖一百，削四階，非奉旨不得錄用。

translations.literal: Deputy Commissioner of Suizhou Affairs Wugusun Alibu was beaten one hundred strokes, stripped of four ranks, and might not be employed again without an imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commissioner of Suizhou Wugusun Alibu was beaten one hundred strokes, stripped of four ranks, and barred from reappointment without an imperial order.

sentences.zh: 於是道改同知大興尹事。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dao was transferred to deputy prefect of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Dao was then appointed deputy prefect of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「京師士民輻湊，犯法者眾，罪狀自實，毋為文所持，斷之以公可也。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In the capital scholars and commoners gather densely; lawbreakers are many; when the facts of guilt are clear, do not let legal technicalities hold sway—judge with fairness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "In the capital scholars and commoners crowd together and offenders are many. When the facts of guilt are clear, do not let legal technicalities hold sway—judge fairly.

sentences.zh: 朕嘗諭執政矣，必不以小苛譴卿，勉副朕意。」

translations.literal: I have already instructed the chief ministers; I will certainly not reprimand you for minor strictness—strive to fulfill my intent."
translations.idiomatic: I have already told the chief ministers that I will not reprimand you for minor strictness. Strive to fulfill my intent."

sentences.zh: 遷刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 尚廄局使宗夔、副使石抹青狗私用官芻，事覺。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Stables Bureau Zongkui and Deputy Director Shimoji Qinggou privately used official fodder; the matter came to light.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Imperial Stables Bureau Zongkui and deputy director Shimoji Qinggou were found to have misappropriated official fodder.

sentences.zh: 尚廄局隸點檢司，刑部當自問。

translations.literal: The Imperial Stables Bureau was subordinate to the Inspection Office; the Ministry of Justice ought to investigate on its own.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Stables Bureau fell under the Inspection Office, and the Ministry of Justice should have investigated the case itself.

sentences.zh: 點檢烏林答天錫屬刑部使輕其罪，刑部以付大興府鞫治，於是道及天錫、郎中丁暐仁皆坐解職。

translations.literal: Inspector Wulindada Tiansi instructed the Ministry of Justice to lighten their crime; the Ministry of Justice handed the case to the Daxing Prefecture for trial; thereupon Dao, Tiansi, and Bureau Director Ding Weiren all were dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Wulindada Tiansi pressed the Ministry of Justice to lighten their offense; the ministry instead referred the case to Daxing prefecture for trial. Dao, Tiansi, and bureau director Ding Weiren were all dismissed from office as a result.

sentences.zh: 尋起為大理卿，兼簽書樞密院事，再遷西京留守，卒。

translations.literal: Soon he was reappointed Director of the Court of Judicial Review, concurrently Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, then again transferred to Western Capital Garrison Commander, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reappointed director of the Court of Judicial Review and concurrent signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, later promoted to garrison commander of the Western Capital, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 高德基

translations.literal: Gao Deji
translations.idiomatic: Gao Deji

sentences.zh: 高德基，字元履，遼陽渤海人。

translations.literal: Gao Deji, courtesy name Yuanyi, was a Bohai native of Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Deji, styled Yuanyi, was a Bohai native of Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 皇統二年登進士第。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangtong he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his jinshi degree in the second year of Huangtong (1142).

sentences.zh: 六年，為尚書省令史。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he served as clerk of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1146) he became a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 海陵為相，專愎自用，人莫敢拂其意，德基每與之詳辨。

translations.literal: When Hailing was chief minister he was obstinate and self-willed; no one dared go against his intent; Deji often argued with him in detail.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing was chief minister he was obstinate and self-willed, and no one dared contradict him; Deji often debated him point by point.

sentences.zh: 及篡位，命左司郎中賈昌祚諭旨曰：「卿公直果敢，今委卿南京行省勾當。」

translations.literal: When he usurped the throne, he ordered Left Bureau Director Jia Changzuo to convey the imperial intent: "You are upright and bold; I now entrust you with affairs of the Nanjing Branch Secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: After he seized the throne, he had Left Bureau Director Jia Changzuo convey his intent: "You are upright and resolute; I now entrust you with affairs of the Nanjing Branch Secretariat."

sentences.zh: 未行，會海陵欲都燕京，命德基攝燕京行台省都事。

translations.literal: Before he departed, it happened that Hailing wished to make Yanjing the capital and ordered Deji to act as chief administrator of the Yanjing Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could depart, Hailing decided to make Yanjing the capital and ordered Deji to serve as acting chief administrator of the Yanjing Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 改攝右司員外郎，除戶部員外郎，改中都路都轉運副使，遷戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He was changed to acting Right Bureau Assistant Director, appointed Assistant Director of the Household Bureau, changed to deputy transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit, and transferred to Bureau Director of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as acting assistant director of the right bureau, appointed assistant director in the Household Bureau, then deputy transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit, and finally director in the Household Bureau.

sentences.zh: 正隆三年，詔左丞相張浩、參知政事敬嗣暉營建南京宮室。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenglong an edict ordered Left Chief Minister Zhang Hao and Vice Grand Councilor Jingsihui to construct the palaces at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenglong (1158) an edict ordered Left Chief Minister Zhang Hao and Vice Grand Councilor Jingsihui to build the palaces at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 明年，德基與御史中丞李籌、刑部侍郎蕭中一俱為營造提點。

translations.literal: The following year Deji, together with Censor-in-Chief Li Chou and Vice Minister of Justice Xiao Zhongyi, all served as construction supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Deji, Censor-in-Chief Li Chou, and Vice Minister of Justice Xiao Zhongyi were all appointed construction supervisors.

sentences.zh: 海陵使中使謂德基等曰：「汝等欲乘傳往邪？

translations.literal: Hailing sent a palace envoy to tell Deji and the others: "Do you wish to go by relay post?
translations.idiomatic: Hailing sent a palace envoy to ask Deji and the others, "Do you wish to travel by relay post?

sentences.zh: 欲乘己馬往邪？

translations.literal: Or do you wish to go on your own horses?
translations.idiomatic: Or on your own horses?

sentences.zh: 銀牌可于南京尚書省取之。」

translations.literal: Silver tablets may be obtained from the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue."
translations.idiomatic: Silver travel tablets may be obtained from the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue."

sentences.zh: 籌乞先降銀牌，複遣中使謂籌曰：「牌之與否，當出朕意，爾敢輒言，豈以三人中官獨高邪？」

translations.literal: Chou requested that silver tablets be issued first; Hailing again sent a palace envoy to tell Chou: "Whether tablets are granted or not should come from my intent—how dare you speak rashly? Do you think yourself alone among the three officials the higher?"
translations.idiomatic: Chou asked that the tablets be issued in advance. Hailing again sent a palace envoy to tell him, "Whether you receive tablets is for me to decide—how dare you speak out of turn? Do you think yourself the senior of the three officials?"

sentences.zh: 遂杖之三十，遣乘己馬往，德基、中一乘傳往。

translations.literal: He thereupon had him beaten thirty strokes and sent him on his own horse; Deji and Zhongyi went by relay post.
translations.idiomatic: He had Chou beaten thirty strokes and sent him on his own horse, while Deji and Zhongyi traveled by relay post.

sentences.zh: 轉同知開封尹。

translations.literal: He was transferred to deputy prefect of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to deputy prefect of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 大定三年，以察廉治狀不善，下遷同知北京路都轉運使事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dading, because his integrity-inspection record was poor, he was demoted to deputy transport commissioner of the Northern Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dading (1163), because his integrity-inspection record was poor, he was demoted to deputy transport commissioner of the Northern Capital circuit.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，土河氾濫，水入京城，德基遽命開長樂門，疏分使入禦溝，以殺其勢，水不能為害。

translations.literal: That autumn the Tu River overflowed and water entered the capital; Deji immediately ordered Changle Gate opened and channels cut to divert the water into the Imperial Moat and reduce its force, so the flood could not do harm.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Tu River flooded and water entered the capital. Deji immediately ordered Changle Gate opened and channels cut to divert the water into the Imperial Moat and reduce its force, so the flood did no harm.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 七年，改中都路都轉運使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1167) he was appointed transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1169) he was appointed minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 有犯罪當死者，宰相欲從末減，德基曰：「法無二門，失出猶失入也。」

translations.literal: When someone guilty of a capital crime was involved, the chief minister wished to reduce the sentence; Deji said: "The law has but one gate; letting a guilty man out is the same as letting an innocent man in."
translations.idiomatic: When someone guilty of a capital crime was involved, the chief minister wished to reduce the sentence. Deji said, "The law has but one gate; letting a guilty man out is the same as letting an innocent man in."

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: They did not follow his view.
translations.idiomatic: They did not follow his view.

sentences.zh: 及奏，上曰：「刑部議，是也。」

translations.literal: When the matter was memorialized, the emperor said: "The Ministry of Justice's deliberation is correct."
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was memorialized, the emperor said, "The Ministry of Justice's deliberation is correct."

sentences.zh: 因召諸尚書諭之曰：「自朕即位以來，以政事與宰相爭是非者，德基一人而已。

translations.literal: He therefore summoned all the ministers and instructed them: "Since I took the throne, only Deji has disputed right and wrong with the chief minister over state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore summoned all the ministers and told them, "Since I took the throne, only Deji has disputed right and wrong with the chief minister over state affairs.

sentences.zh: 自今部上省三議不合，即具以聞。」

translations.literal: From now on, whenever a ministry and the Secretariat disagree after three deliberations, report the matter in full."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, whenever a ministry and the Secretariat disagree after three deliberations, report the matter in full."

sentences.zh: 為宋主生日使。

translations.literal: He served as birthday envoy to the Song emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He served as birthday envoy to the Song emperor.

sentences.zh: 及還，宋人禮物外附進臘茶三千胯，不親封署。

translations.literal: When he returned, apart from the Song gifts an additional three thousand packages of tribute tea were presented, without being personally sealed by him.
translations.idiomatic: On his return, apart from the formal Song gifts, an additional three thousand packages of tribute tea were presented without his personal seal.

sentences.zh: 德基曰：「侄獻叔，而不署，是無名之物也。」

translations.literal: Deji said: "A nephew presents to his uncle yet does not sign—this is an unnamed thing."
translations.idiomatic: Deji said, "A nephew presents to his uncle yet does not sign—this is an unnamed gift."

sentences.zh: 卻之。

translations.literal: He refused it.
translations.idiomatic: He refused it.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was changed to Minister of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Dading (1171) he was appointed minister of the household.

sentences.zh: 德基上疏，乞免軍須房稅等錢，減農稅及鹽酒等課，未報。

translations.literal: Deji submitted a memorial requesting exemption of military requisition housing taxes and other levies, and reduction of agricultural taxes and salt, wine, and other duties; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Deji submitted a memorial asking to abolish military requisition housing taxes and other levies and to reduce agricultural taxes and duties on salt and wine; he received no reply.

sentences.zh: 隨朝官俸粟折錢，增高市價與之，多出官錢幾四十萬貫。

translations.literal: When converting court officials' salary grain to cash, he raised the market price paid to them, spending nearly four hundred thousand strings of official funds in excess.
translations.idiomatic: When converting court officials' salary grain to cash, he paid them at inflated market rates, overspending official funds by nearly four hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 上使人諭之曰：「卿為尚書，取悅宰執近臣，濫出官錢。

translations.literal: The emperor sent someone to instruct him: "As Minister you sought to please the chief ministers and close attendants, wantonly disbursing official funds.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent an envoy to tell him, "As minister you sought to please the chief ministers and close attendants by wantonly disbursing official funds.

sentences.zh: 卿之官爵，一出於朕，奈何如此。」

translations.literal: Your office and rank all come from me—how can you act thus?"
translations.idiomatic: Your office and rank all come from me—how can you act this way?"

sentences.zh: 於是決杖八十，戶部郎中王佐、員外郎盧彥沖、同知中都轉運使劉兟、副使石抹長壽、支度判官韓鎮、左警巡使李克勤、右警巡使李寶、判官強銳昌、姚宗奭、尼龐古達吉不，皆決杖有差。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was sentenced to beating of eighty strokes; Household Bureau Director Wang Zuo, Assistant Director Lu Yanchong, Deputy Transport Commissioner of the Central Capital Liu Shen, Deputy Commissioner Shimoji Changshou, Expenditure Judge Han Zhen, Left Patrol Commissioner Li Keqin, Right Patrol Commissioner Li Bao, and Judges Qiang Ruichang, Yao Zongyi, and Nipanguda Jibu—all received beating sentences in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He was then sentenced to eighty strokes of the rod. Household Bureau director Wang Zuo, assistant director Lu Yanchong, deputy transport commissioner of the Central Capital Liu Shen, deputy commissioner Shimoji Changshou, expenditure judge Han Zhen, left patrol commissioner Li Keqin, right patrol commissioner Li Bao, and judges Qiang Ruichang, Yao Zongyi, and Nipanguda Jibu all received beatings in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 詔自大定十一年十一月郊祀赦後，尚書省、御史台、戶部、轉運司、警巡院多支俸粟折錢，皆追還之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that from after the amnesty following the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Dading, excess salary-grain-to-cash disbursements by the Ministry of Revenue, Censorate, Household Bureau, Transport Office, and Patrol Office were all to be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all excess payments made when converting salary grain to cash by the Ministry of Revenue, Censorate, Household Bureau, transport offices, and patrol offices since the amnesty after the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of Dading 11 be recovered.

sentences.zh: 德基降蘭州刺史，王佐降大興府推官，盧彥沖河北西路戶籍判官，劉兟東京警巡使，石抹長壽東京留守推官，韓鎮河東南路戶籍判官，李克勤通遠縣令，李寶清水縣令，強銳昌、姚宗奭、尼龐古達吉不皆除司候。

translations.literal: Deji was demoted to Lan Prefecture governor; Wang Zuo to Daxing Prefecture investigating officer; Lu Yanchong to household registration judge of Hebei West Circuit; Liu Shen to Eastern Capital patrol commissioner; Shimoji Changshou to Eastern Capital garrison investigating officer; Han Zhen to household registration judge of Hedong South Circuit; Li Keqin to Tongyuan county magistrate; Li Bao to Qingshui county magistrate; Qiang Ruichang, Yao Zongyi, and Nipanguda Jibu all dismissed to station officers.
translations.idiomatic: Deji was demoted to governor of Lan Prefecture; Wang Zuo to investigating officer of Daxing prefecture; Lu Yanchong to household registration judge on the Hebei West Circuit; Liu Shen to patrol commissioner of the Eastern Capital; Shimoji Changshou to investigating officer under the Eastern Capital garrison; Han Zhen to household registration judge on the Hedong South Circuit; Li Keqin to magistrate of Tongyuan county; Li Bao to magistrate of Qingshui county; and Qiang Ruichang, Yao Zongyi, and Nipanguda Jibu were all reduced to station officers.

sentences.zh: 大定十二年，德基卒，年五十四。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Dading Deji died, aged fifty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Dading (1172) Deji died at the age of fifty-four.

sentences.zh: 子錫。

translations.literal: His son was Xi.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Xi.

sentences.zh: 馬諷，字良弼，大興漷陰人。

translations.literal: Ma Feng, courtesy name Liangbi, was a native of Huoyin in Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Feng, styled Liangbi, came from Huoyin in Daxing.

sentences.zh: 國初以燕與宋，諷遊學汴梁，登宣和六年進士第。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the state Yan was given to Song; Feng studied abroad in Bianliang and passed the jinshi examination in the sixth year of Xuanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty Yan was ceded to the Song, and Feng went to study in Bianliang, where he earned his jinshi degree in the sixth year of Xuanhe (1124).

sentences.zh: 宗翰克汴京，諷歸朝，複登進士第，調蔚州廣靈丞，遷雄州歸信令。

translations.literal: When Zonghan took Bianjing, Feng returned to court, again passed the jinshi examination, was appointed assistant magistrate of Guangling in Yu Prefecture, and transferred to magistrate of Guixin in Xiong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Zonghan captured Bianjing, Feng returned to Jin service, passed the jinshi examination again, was appointed assistant magistrate of Guangling in Yu Prefecture, and later became magistrate of Guixin in Xiong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 境有河曰八尺口，每秋潦漲溢害民田，諷視地高下，疏決之，其患遂息。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction was a river called Eight-Foot Mouth; each autumn floods overflowed and harmed the people's fields; Feng surveyed the high and low ground and dredged and channeled it, and the affliction thereupon ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In his jurisdiction was a river called Eight-Foot Mouth that flooded each autumn and ruined farmland. Feng surveyed the terrain, dredged and channeled the river, and the flooding ceased.

sentences.zh: 召為尚書省令史，除獻州刺史。

translations.literal: He was summoned as clerk of the Ministry of Revenue and appointed governor of Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and appointed governor of Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天德初，改寧州，民有告謀不軌者，株連數十百人，諷察其無狀，乃究問告者，告者具伏其誣，眾歡呼感泣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was transferred to Ning Prefecture; a commoner reported a plot of sedition implicating several tens or hundreds of people; Feng investigated and found no substance, then pursued questioning of the accuser; the accuser fully confessed to false accusation; the crowd shouted for joy and wept with gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tiande he was transferred to Ning Prefecture. When someone reported a sedition plot implicating scores of people, Feng found no evidence and interrogated the accuser, who confessed to the false charge. The crowd shouted for joy and wept with gratitude.

sentences.zh: 再遷南京副留守，入為大理少卿。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to deputy garrison commander of Nanjing and entered the capital as Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was later appointed deputy garrison commander of Nanjing, then entered the capital as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 是時，高楨為御史大夫，素貴重，繩治無所避，權貴憚其威嚴，乃以諷及張忠輔為中丞，欲有以中傷之者。

translations.literal: At this time Gao Zhen was Censor-in-Chief, always honored and weighty, punishing without avoidance; the powerful feared his majesty; they therefore made Feng and Zhang Zhongfu censors-in-chief, wishing to have means to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Gao Zhen was censor-in-chief, a man of long-standing prestige who prosecuted without fear. The powerful dreaded his authority, so they appointed Feng and Zhang Zhongfu as censors-in-chief in hopes of finding a way to undermine him.

sentences.zh: 諷、忠輔皆文吏巧法，不能與楨絲發相假借，楨畏其害己，因訴於海陵，海陵以楨太祖舊臣，每慰安之。

translations.literal: Feng and Zhongfu were both civil officials skilled in legal craft; they could not give Zhen the slightest indulgence; Zhen feared they would harm him and therefore appealed to Hailing; Hailing, because Zhen was an old minister of Taizu, always comforted him.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and Zhongfu were both civil officials skilled in legal technicalities and would not give Zhen the slightest indulgence. Zhen feared they would ruin him and appealed to Hailing, who, because Zhen was an old minister of Taizu, always reassured him.

sentences.zh: 諷改大理卿，歲餘出為順天軍節度使。

translations.literal: Feng was transferred to Director of the Court of Judicial Review; after more than a year he went out as military commissioner of Shuntian Army.
translations.idiomatic: Feng was transferred to director of the Court of Judicial Review and, after little more than a year, left the capital as military commissioner of the Shuntian Army.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，複為大理卿，遷刑部尚書，改忠順軍節度使，致仕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he again became Director of the Court of Judicial Review, was transferred to Minister of Justice, changed to military commissioner of Zhongshun Army, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162) he again became director of the Court of Judicial Review, was promoted to minister of justice, then appointed military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army, and retired.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 完顏兀不喝

translations.literal: Wanyan Wubuhe
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Wubuhe

sentences.zh: 完顏兀不喝，會甯府海姑寨人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Wubuhe was a native of Haigu Stockade in Huining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Wubuhe was from Haigu Stockade in Huining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 年十三，選充女直字學生。

translations.literal: At thirteen he was selected to study the Jurchen script.
translations.idiomatic: At thirteen he was chosen to study the Jurchen script.

sentences.zh: 補上京女直吏，再習小字兼通契丹文字。

translations.literal: He was appointed a Jurchen clerk at the Upper Capital, then studied the small script and also mastered Khitan writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a Jurchen clerk at the Upper Capital, then studied the small script and also mastered Khitan writing.

sentences.zh: 充尚書省令史。

translations.literal: He served as clerk of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 天德初，除吏部主事，鞫問押懶路詐襲謀克事，人稱其能，擢右拾遺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was appointed chief clerk of the Personnel Bureau, investigated the fraudulent inheritance of a mouke commission on the Yalan route, was praised for his ability, and was promoted to Right Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tiande he became chief clerk in the Personnel Bureau, investigated a fraudulent mouke inheritance on the Yalan route, won praise for his ability, and was promoted to right remonstrance official.

sentences.zh: 海陵謂之曰：「始聞汝名，試以吏部主事。

translations.literal: Hailing said to him: "When I first heard your name I tried you as chief clerk of the Personnel Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing told him, "When I first heard your name I tried you as chief clerk in the Personnel Bureau.

sentences.zh: 今計其實，優於所聞遠矣。」

translations.literal: Now judging the reality, you are far better than I had heard."
translations.idiomatic: Now that I see the reality, you are far better than I had heard."

sentences.zh: 累遷右司郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to director of the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 從海陵伐宋，至淮南，聞世宗即位于遼陽，兀不喝入白其事，海陵沉思良久，曰：「卿等始聞之邪？

translations.literal: He followed Hailing in the campaign against Song; when they reached Huainan and heard that Shizong had taken the throne at Liaoyang, Wubuhe entered and reported the matter; Hailing pondered a long while and said: "Have you only just heard of this?
translations.idiomatic: He followed Hailing on the campaign against Song. When they reached Huainan and heard that Shizong had taken the throne at Liaoyang, Wubuhe reported the news. Hailing pondered a long while and said, "Have you only just heard of this?

sentences.zh: 我已知之，遣人往矣。

translations.literal: I already know; I have sent someone there.
translations.idiomatic: I already know—I have sent someone there.

sentences.zh: 此大事勿泄於外。」

translations.literal: Do not leak this great matter outside."
translations.idiomatic: Do not leak this great matter outside."

sentences.zh: 大定二年，秩滿當代，世宗嘉其善敷奏，特詔再任，謂宰臣曰：「兀不喝為人公忠，後來有如斯人者，卿等宜薦舉之。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading, when his term expired and he was due to be replaced, Shizong praised his skill at presenting memorials and specially ordered him to serve another term, telling the chief ministers: "Wubuhe is upright and loyal; if later there are men like him, you should recommend them."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162), when his term expired and he was due to be replaced, Shizong praised his skill at presenting memorials and specially ordered him to serve another term. He told the chief ministers, "Wubuhe is upright and loyal; if you later find men like him, you should recommend them."

sentences.zh: 其見知如此。

translations.literal: Such was the esteem in which he was held.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the esteem in which he was held.

sentences.zh: 窩斡已平，詔罷契丹猛安謀克，其元管戶口，及從窩斡作亂來降者，皆隸女直猛安謀克，遣兀不喝于猛安謀克人戶少處分置。

translations.literal: After Wohe was pacified, an edict abolished Khitan regiment and company commands; their original registered households, and those who had followed Wohe in rebellion and come to surrender, were all placed under Jurchen regiment and company commands; Wubuhe was sent to redistribute them in places where regiment and company households were few.
translations.idiomatic: After Wohe was suppressed, an edict abolished Khitan regiment and company commands. Their original registered households, along with those who had joined Wohe's rebellion and later surrendered, were all placed under Jurchen commands, and Wubuhe was sent to redistribute them where Jurchen commands had few households.

sentences.zh: 未經罷去猛安謀克合承襲者，仍許承襲，賑贍其貧乏者，仍括買契丹馬匹，官員年老之馬不在括限。

translations.literal: Those regiment and company commands not yet abolished whose heirs might inherit were still permitted to inherit; the impoverished were given relief; Khitan horses were still purchased by requisition; horses of aged officials were not within the requisition limit.
translations.idiomatic: Commands not yet abolished whose offices could be inherited were still allowed to pass down; the poor were given relief; Khitan horses were still purchased by requisition, though horses belonging to aged officials were exempt.

sentences.zh: 頃之，世宗以諸契丹未嘗為亂者與來降者一概隸女直猛安中，非是，未嘗從亂可且仍舊。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Shizong held that placing all Khitan who had never rebelled together with those who had surrendered under Jurchen regiments alike was wrong; those who had never joined the rebellion might for the time remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Shizong ruled that placing all Khitan who had never rebelled under Jurchen commands together with those who had surrendered was wrong; those who had never joined the rebellion could for the time remain as they were.

sentences.zh: 平章政事完顏元宜奏，已遷契丹所棄地，可遷女直人與不從亂契丹雜處。

translations.literal: Chief Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi memorialized that the abandoned Khitan lands had already been vacated and Jurchen people could be moved to live mixed with Khitan who had not joined the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi memorialized that since the Khitan had abandoned their lands, Jurchen settlers could be moved in to live alongside Khitan who had not joined the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 上以問右丞蘇保衡、參政石琚，皆不能對。

translations.literal: The emperor asked Right Chief Minister Su Baoheng and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Ju; neither could answer.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Right Chief Minister Su Baoheng and Vice Grand Councilor Shi Ju, but neither could answer.

sentences.zh: 上責之曰：「卿等每事先熟議然後奏，有問即對，豈容不知此。」

translations.literal: The emperor reproached them saying: "You always deliberate matters thoroughly before memorializing; when questioned you should answer at once—how can you not know this?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked them: "You are supposed to deliberate matters thoroughly before memorializing and answer immediately when asked—how can you not know this?"

sentences.zh: 保衡、琚頓首謝，上曰：「分隸契丹，以本猛安租稅給贍之，所棄地與附近女直人及餘戶，願居者聽，其猛安謀克官，選契丹官員不預亂者充之。」

translations.literal: Baoheng and Ju bowed their heads in apology; the emperor said: "Separate the subordinate Khitan, support them with the original regiment's rent and tax, give the abandoned lands to nearby Jurchen and remaining households—those who wish to settle may do so—and select Khitan officials who did not join the rebellion to fill the regiment and company posts."
translations.idiomatic: Baoheng and Ju kowtowed in apology. The emperor said, "Assign the Khitan separately and support them with the rent and tax of their original regiment. Give the abandoned lands to nearby Jurchen and remaining households who wish to settle there, and select Khitan officials who did not join the rebellion to fill the regiment and company posts."

sentences.zh: 改同知大興尹，遷橫海軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to deputy prefect of Daxing and promoted to military commissioner of the Henghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed deputy prefect of Daxing and later promoted to military commissioner of the Henghai Army.

sentences.zh: 初到官，讞囚能得其情，人以為不冤。

translations.literal: When he first took office, in judging prisoners he could grasp the true circumstances; people considered that none were wronged.
translations.idiomatic: When he first took office he judged cases so accurately that people believed no one was wrongfully convicted.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died in office.

sentences.zh: 劉徽柔

translations.literal: Liu Huirou
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huirou

sentences.zh: 劉徽柔，字君美，大興安次人。

translations.literal: Liu Huirou, courtesy name Junmei, was a native of Anci in Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Huirou, styled Junmei, came from Anci in Daxing.

sentences.zh: 天眷二年，擢進士第。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan he was selected for the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianjuan (1138) he earned his jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 初為真定欒城主簿，轉開遠軍節度掌書記，遷洪洞令。

translations.literal: He first served as chief clerk of Luancheng in Zhending, was transferred to secretary of the Kaiyuan Army military commission, and promoted to magistrate of Hongdong.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as chief clerk of Luancheng in Zhending, then as secretary on the Kaiyuan Army military commission, and was later promoted to magistrate of Hongdong.

sentences.zh: 徽柔明敏善聽斷。

translations.literal: Huirou was bright and keen, skilled in hearing and deciding cases.
translations.idiomatic: Huirou was intelligent and sharp, skilled at hearing and deciding cases.

sentences.zh: 縣人楊遠者，投牒於縣，以為夜雨屋壞，壓其侄死，號訴哀切。

translations.literal: A man of the county named Yang Yuan submitted a petition to the magistrate, claiming that in the night's rain his house collapsed and crushed his nephew to death, wailing and pleading with piercing grief.
translations.idiomatic: A county man named Yang Yuan filed a petition claiming that during a night rainstorm his house had collapsed and crushed his nephew to death, wailing and pleading with desperate grief.

sentences.zh: 徽柔熟視而笑曰：「汝利侄財而殺之，乃誣雨耶？」

translations.literal: Huirou looked at him closely and laughed, saying: "You coveted your nephew's property and killed him—yet you blame the rain?"
translations.idiomatic: Huirou studied him closely and laughed. "You killed your nephew for his property and now blame the rain?"

sentences.zh: 叱付獄，其人立伏曰：「公神明也，不敢延死。」

translations.literal: He ordered him handed to prison; the man at once confessed, saying: "Your lordship is divine in judgment; I dare not delay death."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the man thrown into prison. The man confessed at once: "Your lordship sees all—I dare not delay my punishment."

sentences.zh: 遂置於法。

translations.literal: He was thereupon executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: He was then executed according to law.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，縣人遮戀不得去者彌日，為立生祠，刻石頌德。

translations.literal: When his term ended, the people of the county blocked his departure in longing for days on end; they built a living shrine for him and carved stone to praise his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, the people blocked his departure for days in their affection for him, built a living shrine in his honor, and carved a stone inscription praising his virtue.

sentences.zh: 正隆二年，入為大理評事，遷司直。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenglong he entered the capital as judicial reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review and was transferred to director of investigations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenglong (1157) he entered the capital as a judicial reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and was promoted to director of investigations.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，同知河東南路轉運使事，以廉第一，改知平定軍，入為大理少卿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he served as deputy transport commissioner of Hedong South Circuit, ranked first in integrity, was changed to military commissioner of Pingding Army, and entered the capital as Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162) he served as deputy transport commissioner of the Hedong South Circuit, ranked first in integrity reviews, was appointed military commissioner of the Pingding Army, and entered the capital as vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 七年，知磁州，改同知南京留守事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he governed Ci Prefecture and was changed to deputy garrison commander of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1167) he governed Ci Prefecture and was appointed deputy garrison commander of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷中都路轉運使，卒官。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1170) he was promoted to transport commissioner of the Central Capital Circuit and died in office.

sentences.zh: 賈少沖

translations.literal: Jia Shaochong
translations.idiomatic: Jia Shaochong

sentences.zh: 賈少沖，字若虛，通州人。

translations.literal: Jia Shaochong, courtesy name Ruoxu, was a native of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Shaochong, styled Ruoxu, came from Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 勤學，日誦數百千言。

translations.literal: He studied diligently and recited several thousand words each day.
translations.idiomatic: He studied diligently and recited several thousand characters each day.

sentences.zh: 家貧甚，嘗道中獲遺金，訪其主歸之。

translations.literal: His family was very poor; once on the road he found lost gold and sought out its owner to return it.
translations.idiomatic: His family was very poor. Once on the road he found lost gold and tracked down its owner to return it.

sentences.zh: 天會中，再伐宋，調及民兵。

translations.literal: During Tianhui the state again campaigned against Song and conscripted local militia.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianhui era the state campaigned against Song again and conscripted local militia.

sentences.zh: 少沖甫冠，代其叔行，雖行伍間，未嘗釋卷。

translations.literal: Shaochong had just come of age and went in place of his uncle; though among the ranks, he never set aside his books.
translations.idiomatic: Shaochong had just come of age and went in his uncle's place. Though he marched with the troops, he never set aside his books.

sentences.zh: 中天眷二年進士。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Tianjuan.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Tianjuan.

sentences.zh: 劉筈欲以妹妻之，少沖辭不就曰：「富貴當自致之。」

translations.literal: Liu Kuo wished to give him his younger sister in marriage; Shaochong declined, saying: "Wealth and honor should be attained by one's own efforts."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kuo wished to marry his younger sister to him, but Shaochong declined, saying, "Wealth and honor must be earned by one's own efforts."

sentences.zh: 調營州軍事判官，遷定安令。

translations.literal: He was appointed military judge of Ying Prefecture and transferred to magistrate of Ding'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military judge of Ying Prefecture and later promoted to magistrate of Ding'an.

sentences.zh: 蔚州刺史恃貴不法，屬吏畏之，每事輒曲從其意，少沖守正不阿。

translations.literal: The governor of Yu Prefecture relied on his noble status and acted unlawfully; subordinate officials feared him and on every matter bent to his will; Shaochong upheld rectitude without flattery.
translations.idiomatic: The governor of Yu Prefecture relied on his noble status and acted unlawfully. His subordinates feared him and bent to his will on every matter, but Shaochong upheld rectitude without flattery.

sentences.zh: 用廉進官一階，再遷吏部主事、定武軍節度副使、河中府判官。

translations.literal: Through integrity he advanced one rank, then was again transferred to chief clerk of the Personnel Bureau, deputy military commissioner of Dingwu Army, and judge of Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted one rank on merit for integrity, he was later appointed chief clerk in the Personnel Bureau, deputy military commissioner of the Dingwu Army, and judge of Hezhong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 海陵浸以失道，少沖謂所親曰：「天下且亂，不可仕也。」

translations.literal: As Hailing gradually lost the Way, Shaochong told those close to him: "The realm will soon fall into disorder; one cannot serve in office."
translations.idiomatic: As Hailing gradually lost his way, Shaochong told those close to him, "The realm will soon fall into chaos. One cannot serve in office."

sentences.zh: 秩滿，乃不求仕。

translations.literal: When his term ended, he did not seek office.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, he did not seek another appointment.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，調御史台典事，累遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he was assigned to the Censorate as clerk and was repeatedly promoted to Bureau Director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162) he was assigned to the Censorate as a clerk and rose through successive posts to director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 往北京決獄，奏誅首惡，誤牽連其中者皆釋不問，全活凡千人。

translations.literal: He went to the Northern Capital to decide cases, memorialized execution of the chief culprits, and released without inquiry all wrongly implicated among them, saving in all nearly a thousand lives.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to the Northern Capital to decide cases, he memorialized for the execution of the chief culprits and released all who had been wrongly implicated, saving nearly a thousand lives in all.

sentences.zh: 以本職攝右司員外郎。

translations.literal: In his original post he acted as Right Bureau Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: While retaining his original post he served as acting assistant director of the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 嘗執奏刑名甚堅，既退，上謂侍臣曰：「少沖居下位，有守如此。」

translations.literal: Once in presenting a memorial on criminal law he was very firm; after he withdrew, the emperor told his attendants: "Shaochong holds a low position yet has such integrity."
translations.idiomatic: Once when presenting a memorial on criminal law he was very firm. After he withdrew, the emperor told his attendants, "Shaochong holds a low position yet has such integrity."

sentences.zh: 除同知河間尹。

translations.literal: He was appointed deputy prefect of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed deputy prefect of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 數月，入為秘書少監，兼起居注、左補闕。

translations.literal: After several months he entered the capital as Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrently Recorder of Imperial Actions and Left Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later he entered the capital as vice director of the Secretariat, while also serving as recorder of imperial actions and left remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 少沖外柔內剛，每從容進諫，世宗稱美之。

translations.literal: Shaochong was outwardly gentle and inwardly firm; he always advanced remonstrances with composure; Shizong praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Shaochong was outwardly gentle but inwardly firm and always offered remonstrances with composure. Shizong praised him for it.

sentences.zh: 十四年，為宋主生日副使，宋國方有祈請，上以意諭少沖，少沖對曰：「臣有死無辱。」

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he served as deputy envoy for the Song emperor's birthday; Song was then making certain requests; the emperor conveyed his intent to Shaochong; Shaochong replied: "Your servant would rather die than be disgraced."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1174) he served as deputy envoy for the Song emperor's birthday. The Song court was making certain requests, and the emperor conveyed his intent to Shaochong, who replied, "I would rather die than be disgraced."

sentences.zh: 宋人別致珍異，少沖笑謂其人曰：「行人受賜自有常數，寧敢以賂辱君命乎。」

translations.literal: The Song people separately presented rare treasures; Shaochong laughed and told their man: "Envoys receive gifts only within fixed limits—how dare one use bribes to dishonor the sovereign's commission?"
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoys separately presented rare treasures. Shaochong laughed and told their representative, "Envoys receive gifts only within fixed limits. How dare I accept a bribe and dishonor the sovereign's commission?"

sentences.zh: 遂不受。

translations.literal: He thereupon did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: He refused to accept them.

sentences.zh: 使還，世宗嘉之，遷右諫議大夫，秘書、起居注如故。

translations.literal: When the mission returned, Shizong commended him and transferred him to Right Remonstrating Grandee; his posts in the Secretariat and as recorder remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the mission returned, Shizong commended him and promoted him to right remonstrating grandee while retaining his posts in the Secretariat and as recorder.

sentences.zh: 十七年請老，除衛州防禦使，遷河東南路轉運使，召為太常卿，兼秘書少監。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he requested retirement and was appointed defense commissioner of Wei Prefecture, transferred to transport commissioner of Hedong South Circuit, summoned as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and concurrently Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1177) he requested retirement and was appointed defense commissioner of Wei Prefecture, then transport commissioner of the Hedong South Circuit, and later summoned as director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices while also serving as vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 複請致仕，不許，改順天軍節度使，卒。

translations.literal: He again requested retirement but was not permitted; he was changed to military commissioner of Shuntian Army and died.
translations.idiomatic: He again requested retirement but was refused and was appointed military commissioner of the Shuntian Army, where he died.

sentences.zh: 少沖性夷簡，不喜言利，嘗教諸子曰：「廕所以庇身，筦庫不可為也。」

translations.literal: Shaochong's nature was easy and simple; he did not like to speak of profit; he once taught his sons: "An official salary is to shelter the body; warehouse clerk posts must not be taken."
translations.idiomatic: Shaochong was easygoing and unpretentious and disliked speaking of profit. He once told his sons, "An official salary shelters the body, but one must never take a warehouse clerk post."

sentences.zh: 聞者尚之。

translations.literal: Those who heard it admired him.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard it admired him.

sentences.zh: 子益。

translations.literal: His son was Yi.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Yi.

sentences.zh: 子 益

translations.literal: Son: Yi
translations.idiomatic: Son: Yi

sentences.zh: 益字損之，少穎悟如成人。

translations.literal: Yi, courtesy name Sunzhi, was from youth clever and perceptive like an adult.
translations.idiomatic: Yi, styled Sunzhi, was clever and perceptive from youth like an adult.

sentences.zh: 大定十四年，父少沖為秘書少監，充宋主生日副使，益侍行。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Dading his father Shaochong was Vice Director of the Secretariat and served as deputy envoy for the Song emperor's birthday; Yi accompanied him on the mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Dading (1174) his father Shaochong, then vice director of the Secretariat, served as deputy envoy for the Song emperor's birthday, and Yi accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 是時，宋人常爭起立接受國書之禮，少沖問益曰：「即宋人欲變禮，持議不決，奈何？」

translations.literal: At this time the Song people often disputed the ritual of standing to receive the state letter; Shaochong asked Yi: "If the Song wish to alter the ritual and hold to their argument without resolution, what then?"
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Song often disputed the ritual of standing to receive the state letter. Shaochong asked Yi, "If the Song wish to alter the ritual and refuse to settle the dispute, what then?"

sentences.zh: 益曰：「守死無辱，可謂使矣。」

translations.literal: Yi said: "Hold to death without disgrace—one may be called an envoy."
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "Hold to death without disgrace—that is what makes a true envoy."

sentences.zh: 少沖大奇之。

translations.literal: Shaochong was greatly astonished by him.
translations.idiomatic: Shaochong was greatly impressed.

sentences.zh: 中大定十九年進士，調河津主簿。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of Dading and was assigned as chief clerk of Hejin.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of Dading (1179) and was appointed chief clerk of Hejin.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂去官，察廉起複礬山令，補尚書省令史。

translations.literal: He left office on mourning for his father; through integrity review he was recalled as magistrate of Fanshan and appointed clerk of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his father, was recalled on merit as magistrate of Fanshan, and was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，除定海軍節度副使，監察御史，治書侍御史，轉侍御史，知登聞鼓院，兼少府少監。

translations.literal: On mourning for his mother, when the mourning period ended he was appointed deputy military commissioner of Dinghai Army, Investigating Censor, Attendant Investigating Censor, transferred to Attending Censor, director of the Petition Drum Office, and concurrently Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother and completing the mourning period, he was appointed deputy military commissioner of the Dinghai Army, investigating censor, attendant investigating censor, attending censor, director of the Petition Drum Office, and concurrently vice director of the Court of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改禮部郎中，兼知登聞鼓院，看讀陳言文字，遷左司郎中，改吏部侍郎，兼蔡王傅。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to Bureau Director of the Ministry of Rites, concurrently director of the Petition Drum Office, reviewing submitted memorial texts, transferred to Left Bureau Director, changed to Vice Minister of Personnel, and concurrently tutor to Prince Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed director in the Ministry of Rites while also directing the Petition Drum Office and reviewing submitted memorials. He was later promoted to director of the left bureau, then vice minister of personnel, and concurrently tutor to Prince Cai.

sentences.zh: 以病免。

translations.literal: He was dismissed on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 除鄭州防禦使，陝西東路轉運使，順天軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was appointed defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, transport commissioner of Shaanxi East Circuit, and military commissioner of Shuntian Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, transport commissioner of the Shaanxi East Circuit, and military commissioner of the Shuntian Army.

sentences.zh: 大安初，召為吏部尚書，有疾，改安國軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was summoned as Minister of Personnel; having an illness, he was changed to military commissioner of Anguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Da'an (1209) he was summoned as minister of personnel, but because of illness was appointed military commissioner of the Anguo Army instead.

sentences.zh: 益調民夫修完城郭，為戰守備，按察司止之，不聽，曰：「治城，守臣事也，按察何預。」

translations.literal: Yi mobilized laborers to repair and complete the walls and ramparts for war and defense preparations; the inspection office stopped him, but he would not listen, saying: "Repairing the walls is the duty of the garrison commander—what business has the inspection office with it?"
translations.idiomatic: Yi mobilized laborers to repair the city walls for defense. The inspection office tried to stop him, but he refused, saying, "Repairing the walls is a garrison commander's duty. What business is it of the inspection office?"

sentences.zh: 既而兵至，以有備解去。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter enemy troops arrived but withdrew because preparations had been made.
translations.idiomatic: When enemy troops arrived shortly afterward, they withdrew because the city was prepared.

sentences.zh: 改 橫海、定國軍節度使，道阻不赴。

translations.literal: He was changed to military commissioner of Henghai and Dingguo armies, but the roads were blocked and he could not go.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military commissioner of the Henghai and Dingguo armies, but the roads were blocked and he could not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 宣宗初為吏部尚書，益為侍郎，相得歡甚，貞祐二年至汴京，訪益所在，召為太常卿。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong first became Minister of Personnel, Yi was vice minister; they got along very well; in the second year of Zhenyou he came to Bianjing, inquired where Yi was, and summoned him as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong first became minister of personnel, Yi was his vice minister and they got along very well. In the second year of Zhenyou (1214) he came to Bianjing, inquired where Yi was, and summoned him as director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 上防秋十三事，與戶部尚書李革論遷河北軍民不便，不報。

translations.literal: He submitted thirteen items on autumn border defense; with Minister of the Household Li Ge he debated the inconvenience of moving the armies and people of Hebei northward; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted thirteen proposals on autumn border defense and debated with Minister of the Household Li Ge the hardships of relocating the armies and people of Hebei northward, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenyou (1215) he retired.

sentences.zh: 元光元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanguang he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanguang (1222) he died.

sentences.zh: 移剌斡里朵

translations.literal: Yila Woliduo
translations.idiomatic: Yila Woliduo

sentences.zh: 移剌斡里朵，一名八斤，系出遼五院司，通契丹字。

translations.literal: Yila Woliduo, also named Bajin, came from the Liao Five Courts Office lineage and was versed in Khitan script.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Woliduo, also known as Bajin, came from the Liao Five Courts Office lineage and was versed in Khitan script.

sentences.zh: 天會三年伐宋，隸軍中，遇戰輒先登，屢獲偵人，有司上其功，補尚書省令史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianhui when campaigning against Song he served in the army; in battle he always charged first; he repeatedly captured scouts; the authorities reported his merit and he was appointed clerk of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Song in the third year of Tianhui (1125) he served in the army, always charging first in battle and repeatedly capturing enemy scouts. The authorities reported his merit and he was appointed a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十五年，籍發諸部兵於山后，將與右丞蕭慶會，時官軍竄而南者凡數千，斡里朵以兵邀擊之，盡獲其輜重財物，悉送有司而去，一毫弗取。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year troops of all departments were registered and mobilized beyond the mountains to join Right Chief Minister Xiao Qinghui; at that time several thousand government troops had fled south; Woliduo intercepted them with troops, captured all their baggage and valuables, sent everything to the authorities and departed, not taking a single hair's worth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1137) troops from all departments were mobilized beyond the mountains to join Right Chief Minister Xiao Qinghui. When several thousand government troops fled south, Woliduo intercepted them, seized all their baggage and valuables, delivered everything to the authorities, and departed without taking a single item for himself.

sentences.zh: 以勞遷修武校尉。

translations.literal: For his labor he was transferred to Xiuwu Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to Xiuwu commandant.

sentences.zh: 宗弼複河南，斡里朵督諸路帥臣進討，事定以勞遷宣武將軍。

translations.literal: When Zongbi reconquered Henan, Woliduo supervised the commanders of all circuits in the advance campaign; when affairs were settled he was transferred to Xuanwu General for his labor.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongbi reconquered Henan, Woliduo supervised the commanders of all circuits in the advance. When the campaign ended he was promoted to Xuanwu general for his service.

sentences.zh: 時六部未分，乃以為兵刑二部主事。

translations.literal: At that time the six ministries were not yet divided, and he was therefore made chief clerk of the War and Justice ministries.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the six ministries had not yet been divided, so he was made chief clerk of the combined War and Justice ministries.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷右司都事。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Right Bureau Chief Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to chief administrator of the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 皇統二年，授大理正，曆同知昭德軍節度使事，以廉升孟州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangtong he was appointed Director of Judicial Review, successively served as deputy military commissioner of Zhaode Army, and through integrity was promoted to defense commissioner of Meng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangtong (1142) he was appointed director of judicial review, later served as deputy military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and was promoted on merit to defense commissioner of Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正隆間，轉同知北京留守事。

translations.literal: During Zhenglong he was transferred to deputy garrison commander of the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenglong era he was appointed deputy garrison commander of the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 會游古河闌子山等猛安契丹謀亂，時方發兵討之，別遣斡里朵押軍南下。

translations.literal: It happened that Khitan regiment commanders of Yougu River, Lanzishan, and other places plotted rebellion; troops were then being mobilized to suppress them; Woliduo was separately sent to escort troops south.
translations.idiomatic: When Khitan regiment commanders at Yougu River, Lanzishan, and elsewhere plotted rebellion, troops were being mobilized to suppress them and Woliduo was separately sent to escort an army south.

sentences.zh: 至松山縣，為賊党江哥所執，且欲推為主盟，要以契約，斡里朵怒曰：「我受國厚恩，豈能從汝反耶？

translations.literal: When he reached Songshan County he was seized by the rebel Jiang Ge, who wished to make him chief of the alliance and demanded he enter a pact; Woliduo angrily said: "I have received deep grace from the state—how can I follow you in rebellion?
translations.idiomatic: At Songshan county he was seized by the rebel Jiang Ge, who wished to make him leader of the alliance and demanded he swear a pact. Woliduo angrily said, "I have received deep favor from the state. How can I follow you in rebellion?

sentences.zh: 寧殺我，契約不可得也。」

translations.literal: Better kill me—the pact cannot be obtained."
translations.idiomatic: You may kill me, but you will never get that pact."

sentences.zh: 賊知不可屈，乃困辱之，使布衣草履逐馬而行，且欲害之。

translations.literal: The rebels knew he could not be bent and therefore humiliated him, made him wear cloth clothes and straw sandals and run after horses, and wished to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels knew he could not be broken and humiliated him, forcing him to wear rough cloth and straw sandals and run after the horses, and even planned to kill him.

sentences.zh: 斡里朵說其監奴，因得脫還。

translations.literal: Woliduo persuaded his guard slave and thereby escaped and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Woliduo persuaded his guard slave and thereby escaped and returned.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，改北京路轉運使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year he was changed to transport commissioner of the Northern Capital Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year he was appointed transport commissioner of the Northern Capital Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大定初，為博州防禦使，再遷利涉軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dading he was defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture and again transferred to military commissioner of Lishe Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Dading he was defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture and later promoted to military commissioner of the Lishe Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，有農民避賊入保郡城，以錢三十千寄之鄰家，賊平索之，鄰人諱不與，訴于縣，縣官以無契驗卻之，乃訴於州。

translations.literal: Earlier, a farmer fleeing bandits entered the walled prefectural city for protection and left thirty thousand cash with a neighbor; when the bandits were pacified he demanded it back; the neighbor denied it; he sued at the county; the county official rejected it for lack of a contract as proof; he then sued at the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier a farmer fleeing bandits had taken refuge in the walled city and left thirty thousand cash with a neighbor. When the bandits were suppressed he demanded it back, but the neighbor denied the debt. The county magistrate rejected the case for lack of a written contract, so he appealed to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 斡里朵陽怒械系之，捕其鄰人，關以三木，詰之曰：「汝鄰乙坐劫殺人，指汝同盜。」

translations.literal: Woliduo feigned anger and had him shackled, seized his neighbor, put him in the cangue, and interrogated him: "Your neighbor Yi is charged with robbery and murder and accuses you as accomplice."
translations.idiomatic: Woliduo feigned anger and had the farmer shackled, then seized the neighbor, put him in the cangue, and interrogated him: "Your neighbor Yi is charged with robbery and murder and accuses you as his accomplice."

sentences.zh: 鄰人大懼，始自陳有欺錢之隙，乃責歸所隱錢而釋之，郡人駭服。

translations.literal: The neighbor was greatly afraid and thereupon confessed that he had concealed the money; he was compelled to return the hidden cash and released; the people of the prefecture were awed into submission.
translations.idiomatic: The neighbor was terrified and confessed that he had concealed the money. Woliduo forced him to return it and released both men. The people of the prefecture were awed into submission.

sentences.zh: 改通遠軍節度使，卒。

translations.literal: He was changed to military commissioner of Tongyuan Army and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army and died in office.

sentences.zh: 阿勒根彥忠

translations.literal: Aleigen Yanzhong
translations.idiomatic: Aleigen Yanzhong

sentences.zh: 阿勒根彥忠，本名窊合山，曷速館人也。

translations.literal: Aleigen Yanzhong, original name Woheshan, was a native of the Hesuguan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Aleigen Yanzhong, whose original name was Woheshan, came from the Hesuguan tribe.

sentences.zh: 好學，通吏事。

translations.literal: He loved learning and was versed in official affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He loved learning and was skilled in official administration.

sentences.zh: 天會十四年，選充尚書兵部孔目官，升尚書省令史，除右司都事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Tianhui he was selected as clerk of the War Bureau of the Ministry of Revenue, promoted to clerk of the Ministry of Revenue, and appointed Right Bureau Chief Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Tianhui (1136) he was selected as a clerk in the War Bureau of the Ministry of Revenue, promoted to a clerk in the ministry, and appointed chief administrator of the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 七年，改大理丞，為會甯少尹，進同知會寧府事，入為尚書吏禮部郎中。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was changed to Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review, served as Vice Magistrate of Huining, advanced to deputy commissioner of Huining Prefecture, and entered the capital as Bureau Director of the Personnel and Rites Bureau of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed assistant director in the Court of Judicial Review, then vice magistrate of Huining, later deputy commissioner of Huining prefecture, and finally entered the capital as director of the Personnel and Rites Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，進本部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan he was promoted to Vice Minister of his bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyuan (1154) he was promoted to vice minister of his bureau.

sentences.zh: 海陵庶人凡有所疑，常使彥忠裁決，彥忠據法以對。

translations.literal: Whenever the deposed Hailing had doubts on any matter he often had Yanzhong decide them; Yanzhong answered according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the deposed Hailing had doubts on any matter he often had Yanzhong decide them, and Yanzhong answered according to law.

sentences.zh: 間有不合，則召讓之，彥忠執奏如前，終無阿屈，同列鹹為懼，彥忠固執不變，海陵壯之。

translations.literal: When occasionally his answers did not accord, Hailing would summon and reproach him; Yanzhong presented his memorial as before, never yielding in flattery; his colleagues were all afraid; Yanzhong firmly held unchanged; Hailing admired him.
translations.idiomatic: When his answers occasionally displeased Hailing, the emperor would summon and reproach him, but Yanzhong presented his views as before and never yielded. His colleagues were all afraid for him, but Yanzhong held firm, and Hailing admired him.

sentences.zh: 明年，除御史中丞，曆尚書戶部侍郎、侍衛親軍副都指揮使。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief, successively served as Vice Minister of the Household Bureau of the Ministry of Revenue and Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed censor-in-chief and later served as vice minister of the Household Bureau and deputy commander-in-chief of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 海陵南伐，除南京路都轉運使。

translations.literal: When Hailing campaigned south he was appointed overall transport commissioner of the Nanjing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: During Hailing's southern campaign he was appointed overall transport commissioner of the Nanjing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，改大名尹，兼本路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading he was changed to prefect of Daming and concurrently overall commander of military forces of that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dading (1162) he was appointed prefect of Daming and concurrently overall commander of military forces on that circuit.
