sentences.zh: 四年，入為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he entered the capital as Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1164) he entered the capital as minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 詔規措北邊艱食戶口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to plan arrangements for impoverished households on the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: He received an edict to arrange relief for impoverished households on the northern border.

sentences.zh: 及泰州、臨潢接境，度宜安置堡戍七十，駐兵萬三千，芻糧之用就經畫之。

translations.literal: At the borders of Taizhou and Linhuang he assessed where to place seventy fort garrisons, stationed thirteen thousand troops, and arranged provisions of fodder and grain on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Along the borders of Taizhou and Linhuang he assessed where to place seventy fort garrisons, stationed thirteen thousand troops, and arranged fodder and grain supplies on the spot.

sentences.zh: 還朝未及入對，以疾卒，年五十三。

translations.literal: He returned to court but before he could have an audience died of illness, aged fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to court but died of illness before he could have an audience, at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 彥忠性孝友，嘗使宋，所得金帛，盡分兄弟親友。

translations.literal: Yanzhong's nature was filial and friendly; once on a mission to Song he divided all the gold and silk he received among brothers and kin.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhong was filial and friendly by nature. On a mission to Song he divided all the gold and silk he received among his brothers and kin.

sentences.zh: 贈榮祿大夫，命有司致祭，並以銀絹賜其家。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Master of Glorious Blessing; the authorities were ordered to perform sacrifices, and silver and silk were bestowed on his family.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title Grand Master of Glorious Blessing, the authorities were ordered to perform sacrifices, and silver and silk were bestowed on his family.

sentences.zh: 張九思

translations.literal: Zhang Jiusi
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiusi

sentences.zh: 張九思，字全行，錦州人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiusi, courtesy name Quanxing, was a native of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiusi, styled Quanxing, came from Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皇統初，補行台省女直譯史，除同知易州事，三遷亳州防禦使、歸德尹。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Huangtong he was appointed Jurchen translator of the Branch Secretariat, appointed deputy commissioner of Yi Prefecture, and through three promotions became defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture and prefect of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Huangtong he was appointed Jurchen translator at the Branch Secretariat, then deputy commissioner of Yi Prefecture, and after three promotions became defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture and prefect of Guide.

sentences.zh: 劉仲延受宋國歲貢於泗州，九思副之。

translations.literal: Liu Zhongyan received the Song state's annual tribute at Sizhou; Jiusi served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zhongyan received the Song state's annual tribute at Sizhou, Jiusi served as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 往歲受歲貢者，每以幣物不精責宋使者，宋使者私饋銀幣各直數百千以為常，九思獨不肯受，仲延從之，自是私饋遂絕。

translations.literal: In past years those receiving the annual tribute often blamed Song envoys when the tribute goods were not fine; Song envoys privately presented silver and coins each worth several hundred or thousand strings as a regular practice; Jiusi alone would not accept; Zhongyan followed him; from then on private gifts ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In past years those receiving the annual tribute often blamed Song envoys when the tribute goods were substandard. Song envoys routinely offered private gifts of silver and coins worth hundreds of thousands of strings. Jiusi alone refused to accept them, Zhongyan followed his example, and private gifts thereafter ceased.

sentences.zh: 自大理評事，再遷大理少卿。

translations.literal: From judicial reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review he was again transferred to Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a judicial reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review, he was later promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 清池令雙申自陳：「父虔，天眷初，知永安軍，遇叛寇孟邦傑，執而脅之，不從，遂被害。

translations.literal: Qingchi Magistrate Shuang Shen submitted on his own behalf: "My father Qian, at the beginning of Tianjuan, governed Yong'an Army; he encountered the rebel Meng Bangjie, who seized and threatened him; he would not submit and was thereupon killed.
translations.idiomatic: Qingchi magistrate Shuang Shen submitted a petition: "My father Qian, early in Tianjuan, governed the Yong'an Army. When he encountered the rebel Meng Bangjie, the rebel seized and threatened him. He refused to submit and was killed.

sentences.zh: 乞正班用廕。」

translations.literal: I beg to use hereditary privilege in the regular ranks."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereditary privilege be granted in the regular ranks."

sentences.zh: 大理寺議，虔子止合雜班敘，九思曰：「虔奮不顧身，守節以死，其子正班用廕，以勸忠孝。」

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review deliberated that Qian's son should only qualify for the miscellaneous ranks; Jiusi said: "Qian exerted himself without regard for his body and died upholding his integrity; his son should use hereditary privilege in the regular ranks to encourage loyalty and filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review ruled that Qian's son qualified only for the miscellaneous ranks. Jiusi said, "Qian gave his life upholding his integrity. His son should receive hereditary privilege in the regular ranks to encourage loyalty and filial piety."

sentences.zh: 世宗從九思議。

translations.literal: Shizong followed Jiusi's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong accepted Jiusi's proposal.

sentences.zh: 改工部郎中，大興少尹，同知中都都轉運使事，轉刑部侍郎，改工部。

translations.literal: He was changed to Bureau Director of the Ministry of Works, Vice Magistrate of Daxing, deputy overall transport commissioner of the Central Capital, transferred to Vice Minister of Justice, and changed to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed director in the Ministry of Works, vice magistrate of Daxing, and deputy overall transport commissioner of the Central Capital, later transferred to vice minister of justice and then back to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 九思所守清約，然急於進取，一切以功利為務，率意任情不恤百姓。

translations.literal: Jiusi maintained integrity and frugality, yet was eager for advancement; he made utility and profit his sole concern and followed his whims without regard for the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi maintained integrity and frugality, yet was eager for advancement, pursued utility and profit above all else, and followed his whims without regard for the common people.

sentences.zh: 詔檢括官田，凡地名疑似者，如皇后店、太子莊、燕樂城之類，不問民田契驗，一切籍之，複有鄰接官地冒占倖免者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered inspection and registration of official fields; wherever place names seemed suspicious, such as Empress Shop, Crown Prince Manor, and Yanyue City, without inquiry into commoners' land contracts as proof, all were registered; moreover some who had encroached on adjacent official land escaped by chance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered inspection and registration of official fields. Wherever place names seemed suspicious, such as Empress Shop, Crown Prince Manor, and Yanyue City, commoners' land contracts were ignored and everything was registered. Some who had encroached on adjacent official land escaped by chance.

sentences.zh: 世宗聞其如是，召還戒之曰：「如遼時支撥地土，及國初元帥府拘刷民間指射租田，近歲冒為己業，此類當拘籍之。

translations.literal: When Shizong heard he acted thus, he summoned him back and admonished him: "Such lands as those allocated in Liao times, and commoners' designated rent fields seized by the Marshal's Headquarters at the beginning of the state, which in recent years have been falsely claimed as private property—these should be seized and registered.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong heard of this, he summoned him back and admonished him: "Lands allocated in Liao times and commoners' designated rent fields seized by the marshal's headquarters at the founding of the state, which in recent years have been falsely claimed as private property—these should be seized and registered.

sentences.zh: 其餘民田，一旦奪之則百姓失業，朕意豈如此也。」

translations.literal: As for the rest of the commoners' fields, to seize them all at once would leave the people without livelihood—is that my intent?"
translations.idiomatic: As for the rest of the commoners' fields, to seize them all at once would leave the people without livelihood. Is that my intent?"

sentences.zh: 轉御史中丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 九思言屯田猛安人為盜征償，家貧輒賣所種屯地。

translations.literal: Jiusi said that when regiment colonists of garrison fields committed theft and were assessed compensation, if their families were poor they would sell the garrison land they had planted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi reported that when regiment colonists on garrison fields committed theft and were assessed compensation, poor families would sell the garrison land they had planted.

sentences.zh: 凡家貧不能征償者，止令事主以其地招佃，收其租入，估賈與征償相當，即以其地還之。

translations.literal: For all whose families were too poor to pay compensation, they need only have the injured party lease out the land, collect its rent, estimate its value against the compensation owed, and then return the land.
translations.idiomatic: For families too poor to pay compensation, the injured party should lease out the land, collect its rent until the value equals the compensation owed, and then return the land.

sentences.zh: 臨洮尹完顏讓亦論屯田貧人征償賣田，乞用九思議，詔從之。

translations.literal: Lintao Prefect Wanyan Rang also discussed poor garrison-field colonists selling land to pay compensation and requested adoption of Jiusi's proposal; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: Lintao prefect Wanyan Rang also discussed poor garrison-field colonists selling land to pay compensation and requested adoption of Jiusi's proposal. An edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 年高，愈自用，上謂左丞張汝弼曰：「九思耄矣，頗執強自用，欲令外補，何如？」

translations.literal: As he grew old he became ever more self-willed; the emperor told Left Chief Minister Zhang Rubi: "Jiusi is aged and rather obstinate and self-willed; I wish to send him out for an external appointment—what do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: As he grew older he became ever more self-willed. The emperor told Left Chief Minister Zhang Rubi, "Jiusi is aged and rather obstinate. I wish to send him out for an external appointment. What do you think?"

sentences.zh: 於是，九思男若拙為尚書省令史，冒填詔敕，事覺，亡命。

translations.literal: Thereupon Jiusi's son Ruozhuo, a clerk of the Ministry of Revenue, falsely filled in an edict; when the matter came to light he fled.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jiusi's son Ruozhuo, a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, falsely filled in an edict. When the matter came to light he fled.

sentences.zh: 汝弼因奏其事，上曰：「九思豈不知若拙處邪？

translations.literal: Rubi thereupon memorialized on the matter; the emperor said: "Could Jiusi not know Ruozhuo's situation?
translations.idiomatic: Rubi memorialized on the matter. The emperor said, "Could Jiusi not know what Ruozhuo was doing?

sentences.zh: 可免其官，捕若拙，獲日授職。」

translations.literal: He may be dismissed from office; arrest Ruozhuo, and when captured grant him a post."
translations.idiomatic: Dismiss him from office, arrest Ruozhuo, and when he is captured grant him a post."

sentences.zh: 九思聞命惶懼，因感疾，卒。

translations.literal: Jiusi heard the order and was fearful; he thereupon fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiusi heard the order and was stricken with fear. He fell ill and died.

sentences.zh: 高衎，字穆仲，遼陽渤海人。

translations.literal: Gao Kan, courtesy name Muzhong, was a Bohai native of Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Kan, styled Muzhong, was a Bohai native of Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 敏而好學，自少有能賦聲，同舍生欲試其才，使一日賦十題戲之，衎執筆怡然，未暮，十賦皆就，彬彬然有可觀。

translations.literal: He was keen and loved learning; from youth he had a reputation for composing fu; a fellow student wished to test his talent and had him compose ten topics in one day as a jest; Kan took up his brush at ease; before evening all ten compositions were finished, refined and worth viewing.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick-witted and loved learning. From youth he had a reputation for composing fu. A fellow student wished to test his talent and assigned him ten topics in one day as a jest. Kan took up his brush calmly, and before evening had finished all ten compositions, each refined and impressive.

sentences.zh: 年二十六登進士第，乞歸養，逾二年方調漷陰丞。

translations.literal: At age twenty-six he passed the jinshi examination, begged to return home to support his parents, and only after more than two years was assigned as assistant magistrate of Huoyin.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-six he passed the jinshi examination, begged to return home to support his parents, and was not assigned as assistant magistrate of Huoyin until more than two years later.

sentences.zh: 召為尚書省令史，除右司都事。

translations.literal: He was summoned as clerk of the Ministry of Revenue and appointed Right Bureau Chief Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and appointed chief administrator of the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 母喪去官，起複吏部員外郎，攝左司員外郎。

translations.literal: On his mother's death he left office; he was recalled as Assistant Director of the Personnel Bureau and acted as Left Bureau Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his mother, was recalled as assistant director in the Personnel Bureau, and served as acting assistant director of the left bureau.

sentences.zh: 王彥潛、常大榮、李慶之皆在吏部選中，吏部擬彥潛、大榮皆進士第一，次當在慶之上，彥潛洺州防禦判官，大榮臨海軍節度判官，慶之沈州觀察判官。

translations.literal: Wang Yanqian, Chang Darong, and Li Qingzhi were all in the Personnel Bureau selection; the bureau proposed Yanqian and Darong both as top jinshi graduates, with Qingzhi next below them—Yanqian as defense judge of Mozhou, Darong as military commission judge of Linhai Army, Qingzhi as observation judge of Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanqian, Chang Darong, and Li Qingzhi were all in the Personnel Bureau selection. The bureau proposed Yanqian and Darong as top jinshi graduates with Qingzhi ranked below them: Yanqian as defense judge of Mozhou, Darong as military commission judge of the Linhai Army, and Qingzhi as observation judge of Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中賈昌祚挾私，欲與慶之洺州，詭曰：「洺雖佳郡，防禦幕官在節鎮下。」

translations.literal: Left Bureau Director Jia Changzuo harbored private favor and wished to give Qingzhi Mozhou; he deviously said: "Though Mozhou is a fine prefecture, the defense staff post is subordinate to the military commission."
translations.idiomatic: Left Bureau Director Jia Changzuo harbored private favor and wished to give Qingzhi Mozhou. He deviously said, "Though Mozhou is a fine prefecture, the defense staff post is subordinate to the military commission."

sentences.zh: 乃改擬彥潛臨海軍，大榮沈州，慶之洺州。

translations.literal: He therefore changed the proposal to Yanqian for Linhai Army, Darong for Shen Prefecture, and Qingzhi for Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore changed the proposal to Yanqian for the Linhai Army, Darong for Shen Prefecture, and Qingzhi for Mozhou.

sentences.zh: 慶之初赴選，昌祚以慶之為會試詮讀官，而慶之弟慶雲為尚書省令史，多與權貴遊，海陵心惡之，嘗謂左右司「昌祚必與慶之善闕」。

translations.literal: When Qingzhi first went to selection, Changzuo made Qingzhi reader for the metropolitan examination, while Qingzhi's younger brother Qingyun was a clerk of the Ministry of Revenue and associated much with the powerful; Hailing hated this in his heart and once told the left and right bureaus that "Changzuo must be partial to Qingzhi."
translations.idiomatic: When Qingzhi first went to selection, Changzuo made him reader for the metropolitan examination, while Qingzhi's younger brother Qingyun was a clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and associated much with the powerful. Hailing disliked this and once told the left and right bureaus, "Changzuo must be partial to Qingzhi."

sentences.zh: 大奉國臣者，遼陽人，永甯太后族人，先為東京警巡院使，以贓免去，欲因太后求見，海陵不許。

translations.literal: Da Fengguochen was a Liaoyang man, a kinsman of Empress Dowager Yongning; he had first served as director of the Eastern Capital Patrol Office and was dismissed for corruption; he wished to seek an audience through the empress dowager; Hailing would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Da Fengguochen was a Liaoyang man and kinsman of Empress Dowager Yongning. He had served as director of the Eastern Capital Patrol Office and was dismissed for corruption. He wished to seek an audience through the empress dowager, but Hailing refused.

sentences.zh: 衎與奉國臣有鄉里舊，擬為貴德縣令。

translations.literal: Kan had old ties with Fengguochen from their home district and proposed him as magistrate of Guide County.
translations.idiomatic: Kan had old ties with Fengguochen from their home district and proposed him as magistrate of Guide county.

sentences.zh: 海陵大怒，於是昌祚、衎、吏部侍郎馮仲等，各杖之有差，慶雲決杖一百五十，罷去。

translations.literal: Hailing was greatly angered; thereupon Changzuo, Kan, Vice Minister of Personnel Feng Zhong, and others each received beatings in varying degrees; Qingyun was sentenced to one hundred fifty strokes and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing was greatly angered. Changzuo, Kan, Vice Minister of Personnel Feng Zhong, and others each received beatings in varying degrees. Qingyun was sentenced to one hundred fifty strokes and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，仲、昌祚、慶雲皆死，衎降為清水縣主簿，兵部員外郎攝吏部主事楊邦基降宜君縣主簿，吏部主事宋仝降漷陰縣主簿，尚書省知除楊伯傑，降閭陽縣主簿。

translations.literal: Before long Zhong, Changzuo, and Qingyun all died; Kan was demoted to chief clerk of Qingshui County; Military Bureau Assistant Director acting Personnel Bureau Chief Clerk Yang Bangji was demoted to chief clerk of Yijun County; Personnel Bureau Chief Clerk Song Tong was demoted to chief clerk of Huoyin County; Ministry of Revenue Appointment Officer Yang Bojie was demoted to chief clerk of Lüyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhong, Changzuo, and Qingyun all died. Kan was demoted to chief clerk of Qingshui county; Yang Bangji, assistant director in the Military Bureau acting as chief clerk in the Personnel Bureau, was demoted to chief clerk of Yijun county; Song Tong, chief clerk in the Personnel Bureau, was demoted to chief clerk of Huoyin county; and Yang Bojie, appointment officer in the Ministry of Revenue, was demoted to chief clerk of Lüyang county.

sentences.zh: 居二年，為大理司直，遷戶部員外郎，同知中都都轉運使，太常少卿，吏部郎中。

translations.literal: After two years he became Director of Investigations of the Court of Judicial Review, transferred to Assistant Director of the Household Bureau, deputy overall transport commissioner of the Central Capital, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Bureau Director of the Personnel Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After two years he became director of investigations in the Court of Judicial Review, then assistant director in the Household Bureau, deputy overall transport commissioner of the Central Capital, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and director in the Personnel Bureau.

sentences.zh: 大定初，轉左司郎中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dading he was transferred to Left Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Dading he was transferred to director of the left bureau.

sentences.zh: 世宗孜孜求諫，群臣承順旨意，無所匡正，上曰：「朕初即位，庶政多未諳悉，實賴將相大臣同心輔佐。

translations.literal: Shizong diligently sought remonstrance, yet the ministers followed his intent without correction; the emperor said: "When I first took the throne I was not yet familiar with many affairs of government and truly relied on the chief ministers and great officials to assist me with one heart.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong diligently sought remonstrance, yet the ministers merely followed his intent without correction. The emperor said, "When I first took the throne I was not yet familiar with many affairs of government and truly relied on the chief ministers and great officials to assist me with one heart.

sentences.zh: 百姓且上書言事，或有所補。

translations.literal: Even commoners submit memorials on affairs and may offer some benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Even commoners submit memorials on affairs and may offer some benefit.

sentences.zh: 夫聽斷獄訟，簿書期會，何人不能，如唐、虞之聖，猶曰'稽於眾，舍己從人'。

translations.literal: As for hearing and deciding lawsuits, documents and scheduled meetings—who cannot do these? Yet even the sages of Tang and Yu said 'consult the multitude and set aside oneself to follow others.
translations.idiomatic: As for hearing lawsuits and managing documents and schedules, who cannot do these? Yet even the sages of Tang and Yu said, 'consult the multitude and set aside oneself to follow others.

sentences.zh: 正隆專任獨見，不謀臣下，以取敗亂。

translations.literal: Zhenglong relied solely on his own views and did not consult his ministers, thereby bringing defeat and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenglong relied solely on his own views and did not consult his ministers, thereby bringing defeat and disorder.

sentences.zh: 卿等其體朕意。」

translations.literal: You should embody my intent."
translations.idiomatic: You should embody my intent."

sentences.zh: 使潔傳詔台省百司曰：「凡上書言事，或為有司沮遏，許進表以聞。」

translations.literal: He had Jie transmit an edict to the Censorate, Secretariat, and all offices: "For all who submit memorials on affairs, if they are obstructed by officials, they may present a memorial to reach the throne."
translations.idiomatic: He had Jie transmit an edict to the Censorate, Secretariat, and all offices: "For all who submit memorials on affairs, if they are obstructed by officials, they may present a memorial to reach the throne."

sentences.zh: 遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 每季選人至，吏部托以檢閱舊籍，謂之檢卷，有滯留至後季猶不得去者。

translations.literal: Each season when candidates arrived, the Personnel Bureau used review of old registers as a pretext, calling it 'register inspection'; some were detained until the next season and still could not depart.
translations.idiomatic: Each season when candidates arrived, the Personnel Bureau used review of old registers as a pretext, calling it register inspection. Some were detained until the next season and still could not depart.

sentences.zh: 衎三為吏部，知其弊，歲餘銓事修理，選人便之。

translations.literal: Kan served three times in the Personnel Bureau and knew its abuses; within a year the selection affairs were put in order and candidates found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Kan served three times in the Personnel Bureau and knew its abuses. Within a year he put selection affairs in order, to the convenience of candidates.

sentences.zh: 五年，為賀宋國生日使，中道得疾，去職。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he served as envoy to congratulate the Song state on the emperor's birthday; mid-journey he fell ill and left office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he served as envoy to congratulate the Song emperor on his birthday, fell ill en route, and left office.

sentences.zh: 大定七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dading he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Dading (1167) he died.

sentences.zh: 楊邦基

translations.literal: Yang Bangji
translations.idiomatic: Yang Bangji

sentences.zh: 楊邦基，字德懋，華陰人。

translations.literal: Yang Bangji, courtesy name Demao, was a native of Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Bangji, styled Demao, came from Huayin.

sentences.zh: 父綯，宋末為易州州佐。

translations.literal: His father Chao served as assistant prefect of Yi Prefecture at the end of Song.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chao served as assistant prefect of Yi Prefecture at the end of the Song.

sentences.zh: 宗望伐宋，蔡靖以燕山降，易州即日來附，綯被殺，邦基年十餘歲，匿僧舍中，得免。

translations.literal: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Cai Jing surrendered Yan Mountains; Yi Prefecture submitted the same day; Chao was killed; Bangji was just over ten years old and hid in a monastery, thereby escaping.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Cai Jing surrendered the Yan Mountains region and Yi Prefecture submitted the same day. Chao was killed. Bangji, just over ten years old, hid in a monastery and escaped.

sentences.zh: 既長，好學。

translations.literal: When he grew up he loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew up he loved learning.

sentences.zh: 天眷二年，登進士第，調灤州軍事判官，遷太原交城令。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan he passed the jinshi examination, was assigned military judge of Luan Prefecture, and transferred to magistrate of Jiaocheng in Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianjuan (1138) he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed military judge of Luan Prefecture, and later became magistrate of Jiaocheng in Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 太原尹徒單恭貪污不法，託名鑄金佛，命屬縣輸金，邦基獨不與。

translations.literal: Taiyuan Prefect Tushan Gong was corrupt and unlawful; under the pretext of casting a golden Buddha he ordered subordinate counties to supply gold; Bangji alone would not contribute.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan prefect Tushan Gong was corrupt and unlawful. Under the pretext of casting a golden Buddha he ordered subordinate counties to supply gold, but Bangji alone refused to contribute.

sentences.zh: 徒單恭怒，召至府，將以手持鐵拄杖撞邦基面，邦基不動。

translations.literal: Tushan Gong was angry, summoned him to the prefecture, and was about to strike Bangji's face with an iron staff held in his hand; Bangji did not flinch.
translations.idiomatic: Tushan Gong was angry and summoned him to the prefecture, about to strike his face with an iron staff. Bangji did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 秉德廉察官吏，尹與九縣令皆免去，邦基以廉為河東第一，召為禮部主事。

translations.literal: Bingde conducted integrity review of officials; the prefect and nine county magistrates were all dismissed; Bangji ranked first in Hedong for integrity and was summoned as chief clerk of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Bingde conducted an integrity review of officials, and the prefect and nine county magistrates were all dismissed. Bangji ranked first in Hedong for integrity and was summoned as chief clerk in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 以兵部員外郎攝吏部差除，坐銓注李慶之、大奉國臣，與高衎等皆貶官，邦基降坊州宜君簿。

translations.literal: As Military Bureau Assistant Director acting for Personnel Bureau appointments, he was punished for appointing Li Qingzhi and Da Fengguochen; together with Gao Kan and others all were demoted; Bangji was demoted to clerk of Yijun in Fang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As assistant director in the Military Bureau acting for Personnel Bureau appointments, he was punished for appointing Li Qingzhi and Da Fengguochen. Together with Gao Kan and others he was demoted, Bangji to clerk of Yijun in Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 轉高密令。

translations.literal: He was transferred to magistrate of Gaomi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to magistrate of Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 大定初，尚書省擬邦基刑部郎中，世宗曰：「縣官即除郎中，如何？」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dading the Ministry of Revenue proposed Bangji as Bureau Director of the Ministry of Justice; Shizong said: "A county magistrate immediately made bureau director—how can that be?"
translations.idiomatic: Early in Dading the Ministry of Revenue proposed Bangji as director in the Ministry of Justice. Shizong said, "A county magistrate immediately made bureau director—how can that be?"

sentences.zh: 太師張浩對曰：「邦基前為兵部員外郎矣，且其人材可用。」

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Zhang Hao replied: "Bangji was previously Military Bureau Assistant Director, and moreover his talent may be used."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Zhang Hao replied, "Bangji was previously assistant director in the Military Bureau, and moreover his talent may be used."

sentences.zh: 上許之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 改太府少監，知登聞檢院，為秘書少監，遷翰林直學士，再遷秘書監兼左諫議大夫，修起居注。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury, director of the Petition Inspection Office, appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, transferred to Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, again transferred to Director of the Secretariat concurrently Left Remonstrating Grandee, and compiled the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury and director of the Petition Inspection Office, then vice director of the Secretariat, Hanlin academician-in-attendance, director of the Secretariat concurrently left remonstrating grandee, and compiler of the imperial diary.

sentences.zh: 中都警巡使張子衍與邦基姻家，子衍道中遇皇太子衛仗，立馬市門不去傘，衛士訶之，子衍以鞭鞭衛士訶己者。

translations.literal: Central Capital Patrol Commissioner Zhang Ziyan was related to Bangji by marriage; Ziyan encountered the Crown Prince's guard on the road, stood his horse at the market gate without lowering his umbrella; guards rebuked him; Ziyan whipped the guard who had rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital patrol commissioner Zhang Ziyan was related to Bangji by marriage. Ziyan encountered the crown prince's guard on the road, stood his horse at the market gate without lowering his umbrella, and when guards rebuked him, whipped the guard who had done so.

sentences.zh: 御史台劾奏子衍，邦基見台官為子衍求解，及入見顯宗，求脫子衍罪。

translations.literal: The Censorate impeached and memorialized against Ziyan; Bangji saw censorate officials to seek leniency for Ziyan; when he had an audience with Xianzong he sought release from Ziyan's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate impeached Ziyan. Bangji appealed to censorate officials on his behalf and, at an audience with Xianzong, sought to have his punishment lifted.

sentences.zh: 詔削子衍官兩階。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Ziyan of two ranks in office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Ziyan of two ranks in office.

sentences.zh: 邦基坐削官一階，出為同知西京留守事，徙山東東路轉運使，永定軍節度使，致仕。

translations.literal: Bangji was punished by stripping one rank, went out as deputy garrison commander of the Western Capital, was moved to transport commissioner of Shandong East Circuit, military commissioner of Yongding Army, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Bangji was stripped of one rank, appointed deputy garrison commander of the Western Capital, later transport commissioner of the Shandong East Circuit and military commissioner of the Yongding Army, and retired.

sentences.zh: 大定二十一年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Dading he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Dading (1181) he died.

sentences.zh: 邦基能屬文，善畫山水人物，尤以畫名當世雲。

translations.literal: Bangji could compose literary works and was skilled at painting landscapes and figures; he was especially renowned in his age for painting.
translations.idiomatic: Bangji could compose literary works and was skilled at painting landscapes and figures. He was especially renowned in his age for his painting.

sentences.zh: 丁暐仁

translations.literal: Ding Weiren
translations.idiomatic: Ding Weiren

sentences.zh: 丁暐仁，字藏用，大興府宛平人。

translations.literal: Ding Weiren, courtesy name Cangyong, was a native of Wanping in Daxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Weiren, styled Cangyong, came from Wanping in Daxing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曾祖奭。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather was Shuang.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather was Shuang.

sentences.zh: 祖惟壽。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Weishou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Weishou.

sentences.zh: 父筠，以吏補州縣，所至有治聲，其後致仕，杜門不出，鄉里有鬥訟者，不之官而就筠質焉。

translations.literal: His father Jun entered office through clerical service in prefectures and counties; wherever he went he had a reputation for good governance; afterward he retired, shut his door and did not go out; when neighbors had disputes they did not go to officials but came to Jun for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jun entered office through clerical service in prefectures and counties and wherever he went earned a reputation for good governance. After retiring he shut his door and rarely went out. When neighbors had disputes they did not go to officials but came to Jun for judgment.

sentences.zh: 暐仁沖澹寡欲，讀書之外，無他好，遼季避難，雖間關道途，未嘗釋卷。

translations.literal: Weiren was mild and of few desires; apart from reading books he had no other pursuits; during the turmoil at the end of Liao, though the roads were perilous, he never set aside his books.
translations.idiomatic: Weiren was mild and of few desires. Apart from reading he had no other pursuits. During the turmoil at the end of the Liao, though the roads were perilous, he never set aside his books.

sentences.zh: 皇統二年，登進士第，調武清縣丞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangtong he passed the jinshi examination and was assigned as assistant magistrate of Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangtong (1142) he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed assistant magistrate of Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 縣經兵革後，無學校，暐仁召邑中俊秀子弟教之學，百姓欣然從之。

translations.literal: The county after warfare had no school; Weiren summoned talented youths of the district to teach them; the common people gladly followed.
translations.idiomatic: The county had no school after the warfare. Weiren summoned talented youths of the district to teach them, and the common people gladly followed.

sentences.zh: 調磁州軍事判官。

translations.literal: He was assigned military judge of Ci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military judge of Ci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是時，詔使廉察官吏，暐仁以廉攝守事。

translations.literal: At this time an edict sent envoys to conduct integrity review of officials; Weiren through integrity acted as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict sent envoys to conduct integrity reviews of officials, and Weiren was promoted on merit to act as prefect.

sentences.zh: 遷和川令。

translations.literal: He was transferred to magistrate of Hechuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to magistrate of Hechuan.

sentences.zh: 前令罷耎不事事，群小越法幹禁無所憚，暐仁申明法禁，皆屏息，或走入他縣以避之。

translations.literal: The previous magistrate was weak and inactive; petty men violated the law and overstepped prohibitions without fear; Weiren clarified the law and prohibitions; all fell silent, and some fled to other counties to avoid him.
translations.idiomatic: The previous magistrate was weak and inactive. Petty men violated the law without fear. Weiren clarified the law and prohibitions, and all fell silent; some fled to other counties to avoid him.

sentences.zh: 有董佑者最強悍，畏服暐仁，以刀斷指，誓終身不復犯法。

translations.literal: One Dong You was the most fierce; in awe of Weiren he cut off a finger with a knife and swore never again to violate the law in his life.
translations.idiomatic: One Dong You was the most fierce. In awe of Weiren he cut off a finger with a knife and swore never again to violate the law.

sentences.zh: 凡租賦與百姓前為期率，比他邑先辦。

translations.literal: All rent and tax collections were made ahead of schedule with the common people, completed before other districts.
translations.idiomatic: All rent and tax collections were completed ahead of schedule, before other districts.

sentences.zh: 曆北京推官，再遷大理司直，以憂去官，尋起複。

translations.literal: He successively served as investigating officer of the Northern Capital, was again transferred to Director of Investigations of the Court of Judicial Review, left office on mourning, and was soon recalled.
translations.idiomatic: He served as investigating officer of the Northern Capital, was later promoted to director of investigations in the Court of Judicial Review, left office to mourn, and was soon recalled.

sentences.zh: 大定三年，除定武軍節度副使，而節度使、同知皆闕，暐仁為政無留訟。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dading he was appointed deputy military commissioner of Dingwu Army; both the military commissioner and deputy commissioner posts were vacant; Weiren governed with no cases left pending.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dading (1163) he was appointed deputy military commissioner of the Dingwu Army. Both the military commissioner and deputy commissioner posts were vacant, and Weiren governed with no cases left pending.

sentences.zh: 改大理丞，吏部員外郎，轉戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He was changed to Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review, Assistant Director of the Personnel Bureau, and transferred to Bureau Director of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed assistant director in the Court of Judicial Review, assistant director in the Personnel Bureau, and director in the Household Bureau.

sentences.zh: 於是，賈少沖為刑部郎中，上謂左丞相紇石烈良弼曰：「少沖為人柔緩，不稱刑部之職，其議易之。」

translations.literal: At this time Jia Shaochong was Bureau Director of the Ministry of Justice; the emperor told Left Chief Minister Heshenilie Liangbi: "Shaochong is mild and slow by nature and does not suit the Ministry of Justice—discuss replacing him."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jia Shaochong was director in the Ministry of Justice. The emperor told Left Chief Minister Heshenilie Liangbi, "Shaochong is mild and slow by nature and does not suit the Ministry of Justice. Discuss replacing him."

sentences.zh: 乃以暐仁為刑部郎中。

translations.literal: Weiren was therefore made Bureau Director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Weiren was therefore appointed director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 坐尚廄局官私用官芻，違格付大興府鞫問，解職。

translations.literal: He was punished for Imperial Stables Bureau officials' private use of official fodder; contrary to regulations the case was handed to Daxing Prefecture for trial; he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for the Imperial Stables Bureau officials' private use of official fodder when, contrary to regulations, the case was referred to Daxing prefecture for trial.

sentences.zh: 改祁州刺史。

translations.literal: He was changed to governor of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor of Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祁州為定武支郡，士民聞暐仁之官，相率歡迎界上，相屬不絕。

translations.literal: Qi Prefecture was a subordinate prefecture of Dingwu; scholars and commoners hearing of Weiren's appointment came in groups to welcome him at the border, one after another without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Prefecture was a subordinate prefecture of Dingwu. Scholars and commoners hearing of Weiren's appointment came in groups to welcome him at the border without cease.

sentences.zh: 改同知西京留守事，首興學校，以明養士之法。

translations.literal: He was changed to deputy garrison commander of the Western Capital, first established schools, and clarified methods for nurturing scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed deputy garrison commander of the Western Capital, where he first established schools and clarified methods for nurturing scholars.

sentences.zh: 遷陝西西路轉運使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to transport commissioner of Shaanxi West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to transport commissioner of the Shaanxi West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大定二十一年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Dading he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Dading (1181) he died in office.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：吏之興，其秦之季邪？

translations.literal: The commentary says: Did the rise of clerks occur at the end of Qin?
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Did the rise of clerks occur at the end of Qin?

sentences.zh: 吏有選試，其遼、金之際邪？

translations.literal: Did clerks gain selection examinations at the transition between Liao and Jin?
translations.idiomatic: Did clerks gain selection examinations at the transition between Liao and Jin?

sentences.zh: 其文從一從史，守法不貳之謂邪？

translations.literal: Does the character for clerk, composed of 'one' and 'history,' mean upholding the law without deviation?
translations.idiomatic: Does the character for clerk, composed of one and history, mean upholding the law without deviation?

sentences.zh: 守法不貳，斯真吏矣。

translations.literal: To uphold the law without deviation—this is the true clerk.
translations.idiomatic: To uphold the law without deviation—that is the true clerk.

sentences.zh: 巧者舞文以亂法，窒者執一而弗通，此皆吏道之自失者也。

translations.literal: The clever twist documents to disorder the law; the obstructed cling to one thing and cannot adapt—these are all ways the clerk's path loses itself.
translations.idiomatic: The clever twist documents to subvert the law; the rigid cling to one thing and cannot adapt—these are all ways the clerk's path loses itself.

sentences.zh: 高衎、高德基、張九思之徒，皆詭法以自失者矣。

translations.literal: Gao Kan, Gao Deji, Zhang Jiusi, and men like them all perverted the law and thereby lost themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Kan, Gao Deji, Zhang Jiusi, and men like them all perverted the law and thereby lost themselves.
